name: Chromium v154.0.8037.57.2 — Stealth Build (Pro)
body:
## CloakBrowser Pro: Linux Stable advances to Chromium 154.0.8037.57.2

Chromium `154.0.8037.57.2` is now Stable on **Linux** (x64 and ARM64). Windows and macOS Stable stay on `154.0.8037.57.1`.

With a valid CloakBrowser key, the wrapper automatically selects the Stable build for your platform. No version pin is required.

### What's new since 154.0.8037.57.1 (Linux)

- **3 to 6 times less CPU** when running headed in Docker or on a GPU-less Linux server. Headless mode and machines with a real GPU are not affected.
- **Safer proxy handling.** Proxy passwords with special characters now work, and a proxy setting the browser cannot read stops the connection instead of going out without the proxy.
- **A more patient license connection**, with a new `--license-route=auto|direct|proxy` flag. `auto` is the default and works as before.
- **Windows persona hardware follows the graphics model.** On Intel graphics profiles, a fixed seed may report different core and memory values than before.
- **Windows persona fonts match real Windows by default** when the real Windows fonts are installed, so `--fingerprint-windows-font-metrics` is no longer needed.
- **The macOS persona on Linux** matches a real Mac in two more details.

Your profiles, cookies, and seeds are untouched. Only the browser itself is replaced.

### Current wrapper: v0.6.2

Update the wrapper before launching:

```bash
pip install -U cloakbrowser
npm update cloakbrowser
dotnet add package CloakBrowser --version 0.6.2
```

### Roll back if needed

If a workload regresses, pin the previous Linux Stable build:

```bash
export CLOAKBROWSER_VERSION=154.0.8037.57.1
```

Remove the pin to return to the newest Stable build.

**If you hit a regression, please tell us.** [Open an issue](https://github.com/CloakHQ/CloakBrowser/issues) or email support@cloakbrowser.dev with the site and what you saw. Pinning the old build gets you unblocked; a report gets it fixed for everyone.

### Checksums (SHA-256)

```text
version=154.0.8037.57.2
cee9eeda5d64b0a477b3a3f2ea6c99edb6fdd3ef840b91eca90ff4f37e538a63  cloakbrowser-linux-x64.tar.gz
4a648032b2a1f96fc30bc1dcb73c608abe1c09654e92d28844c50e50e915fb61  cloakbrowser-linux-arm64.tar.gz
```

The signed manifest (`SHA256SUMS` and `SHA256SUMS.sig`) is attached. The wrapper verifies its Ed25519 signature and each archive's SHA-256 checksum automatically.

name: Reasonix CLI v2.40.0
body:
CLI archives built from the Studio release [studio-v2.40.0](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases/tag/studio-v2.40.0).

This release fixes the unclickable workspace "+" button, adds a turn-narration setting, and lets the changelog switch between Chinese and English.

## New

- The feedback dialog gains "Capture this window": it takes one picture of the app window only when you click, adds it as a removable thumbnail, and never sends it on its own. Refs #11965.
- The session tree now carries each conversation's last-activity time, so a list can sort by recency or show a relative time. Refs #12011.
- A sub-agent queued behind another's write claim now says whose claim it waits on, and whether neither declared write_paths (each treated as writing the whole workspace). Refs #12052.
- Theme packs gain `shadowFloat`, the shadow menus, popovers and dialogs cast; unset keeps the built-in one. Refs #12063.
- Charts now write each value beside its bar or line point while the plot is sparse, and draw none when there are too many marks to read; hover readout is unchanged. Refs #12291.
- Projects in the sidebar can now be reordered by dragging a row; a line on the target's top or bottom edge shows where it lands, and the order is kept by the kernel. Refs #12300.
- The "Worked for" line at the end of a turn now also says when the turn began (time of day for today, with the date for another day), and it survives reopening the session. Refs #12728.
- Settings > Account gains "Export and import config": no account needed; export an encrypted file and import it item by item elsewhere. Keys off by default; a passphrase is required. Refs #12736.
- Settings → Session gains "Narration between tool calls": Detailed asks the model for three or four lines between batches of tool calls; Brief, the default, changes nothing. Refs #12788.
- The project menu gains "Open with …": besides the file manager, open a project folder in the VS Code, Cursor, IntelliJ IDEA or system terminal this machine has installed. Refs #12858.
- The workbench explorer gains a "Commit history" section: opened, it lists the newest commits of every branch as a graph, with branches and tags. Refs #12913.
- Settings → Appearance gains a "Sessions from 1.x" switch to hide migrated 1.x sessions from the sidebar; shown by default, nothing is deleted. Refs #12964.
- In the terminal UI, `/theme` now opens a picker that previews each row as you move, keeps it on Enter and restores the original on Esc; `/theme list` still prints the names. Refs #12985.
- When the context is over the compaction threshold with nothing to fold, a notice now says what holds the tokens, by class and largest items. Refs #13013.
- Local stdio MCP servers now receive the extra folders you allowed tools to write in `_meta["io.reasonix/writableRoots"]`; remote ones do not. Refs #13053.
- First-run setup gains "Not now": open the workbench first, with a note above the input box leading back to setup; this launch only, offered again next time. Refs #13065.
- The bottom "Generation speed" detail gains "Time to first token" (request sent to first output, timed by the kernel) and now uses the same row layout as the context detail. Refs #13075.
- Adding a project now selects it and opens a new session in it (nothing is sent for you), whether through "Open or create project", the first-run prompt or a folder drop. Refs #13076.
- New floating "Back to top" / "Jump to latest" buttons in the conversation (hidden near an end or when nothing scrolls) land on the nearest expanded block first. Refs #13077.
- The Versions page can switch a release's notes between Chinese and English, following the interface language by default; every release's notes now carry English. Refs #13081.

## Changed

- The Files button in the rail and sidebar now toggles: pressed while the files panel is open it folds it, and it reopens after the panel was closed elsewhere. Refs #12925.
- The composer's model menu now sets provider headings apart, indents the models, and adds multi-select provider chips that are remembered. Refs #12926.
- Restore the black-and-gold application, taskbar/Dock, launcher and tray icons. Refs #13004.
- Sent pictures, pictures waiting in the composer and tool screenshots share one viewer: open the original, Esc to leave, focus returns. Refs #13006, #13010.
- The Settings sidebar's selected row no longer carries the accent colour, outline and edge bar, only a deeper fill; section titles are lighter than the items under them. Refs #13045, #13046.
- The title-bar Browser button is gone: the Workbench tab is the one way in, and with nothing running it shows the Files / Changes / Browser start page instead of opening a blank page. Refs #13067.
- Session rows no longer show the hover Archive and Delete icons; both stay in the right-click menu, and the Delete key still works. Refs #13068.

## Fixed

- When the model cannot draft a commit message, the commit card still lists the staged files and says why; type the message and commit. Refs #12747.
- The context gauge now reads the provider's reported size plus what grew since, instead of the larger of that and the local estimate, so an estimate running high no longer inflates it. Refs #12988.
- A read-only `find ... -exec wc/grep/cat/stat ...` is no longer treated as a write, so it does not claim the workspace write lease or collide with another session's edit. Refs #12993.
- The repeated-output guard now also flags a stream that collapses to a few tiny lines in no fixed order; before it only saw byte-identical loops. Refs #13001.
- Each sub-agent in the sub-agents popover now shows its own task title (the first line of its description, cut to fit, full text on hover), so parallel ones no longer all read "task". Refs #13002.
- Switching to a long session no longer shows "could not restore extension surfaces"; you hear once only if a surface was dropped. Refs #13011.
- On the run-analysis signal rail, marks too close together now share one counted marker that opens a list, instead of stacking into a tall column. Refs #13034.
- Fixed the project row's "…" button answering only at its corners: the faded count badge kept sitting over it and taking the click; it no longer takes the pointer. Refs #13036, #13038.
- The magnifier beside the session filters is now a real toggle: pressing it again closes the find box instead of replaying its opening animation. Refs #13041.
- The "+" that opens or creates a project folder on the sidebar's "This machine" row is now always visible instead of appearing only when the row is hovered. Refs #13043, #13072.
- Fixed the branch hover card staying on screen under the branch menu and stacking a second shadow. Refs #13044.
- The red notice raised when reading the session status fails on reload now clears itself when that read next succeeds, instead of waiting for "Got it". Refs #13047.
- Failures that do not block sending now show as corner notices (three at most, dismissed only by you) with "Report this problem". Refs #13047, #13048.
- The extension-surface, MCP catalog and changed-files reads treat a missing list as empty instead of raising "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')". Refs #13055.
- The branch list, event replay and queue now answer an empty list instead of null when they are empty, so the page no longer fails reading them. Refs #13055.
- The "Report this problem" entry on error bars and corner notices now also writes a page defect's error name and where it came from (file name and line only) into the feedback draft. Refs #13055.
- A red notice under the composer that comes from a defect of the page itself (for example "Cannot read properties of undefined") now also logs its stack to the console. Refs #13055.
- Uploading a large image or file from the phone remote page no longer drops the connection: an oversized request is refused on the phone with a clear message and the link keeps working. Refs #13056.
- The phone remote page can now upload larger images and files, sent as several messages and handled once the desktop has them all (up to 16 MB). Refs #13056.
- Fixed the repeated "Checkpoint recording failed" warning for writes outside the workspace, such as the session temp folder: they are now a coverage gap, not a failure. Refs #13060.
- Fixed the kernel crashing when an MCP server fails to launch or reconnect: a failed server now only becomes unavailable, nothing else is affected. Refs #13086.
- Fixed one likely cause of broken images (such as the sidebar wordmark) on some Windows machines: the page's file types no longer follow other programs' registry entries. Refs #13094.

name: Reasonix CLI v2.39.0
body:
CLI archives built from the Studio release [studio-v2.39.0](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases/tag/studio-v2.39.0).


## Changes in 2.39.0

This release adds double-click rename for sessions, starting without any model service, a low-disk-space warning and maps and dashboards in extension surfaces, and tidies the sidebar and conversation display.

## New

- Double-click a session row in the sidebar to rename it in place; the rename dialog can generate a title on request (#12977, #11591 by @Guan0923)
- Reasonix starts without any model service configured and opens the connection guide directly (#12966)
- A warning appears when the disk holding a project or session is nearly full; on by default, it only warns and never deletes files (#12960)
- The terminal UI reports working, waiting-for-you and finished states to the terminal (#12976)
- A finished session can stay in the Running list for a chosen time; off by default (#12957)
- The sidebar marks sessions stored by 1.x, and the terminal resume list marks sessions you have not viewed (#12405, #12587)
- A skill invoked with / shows as a compact skill block, and the JSON input of tool calls is syntax-coloured (#12972, #12969)
- Files can be staged and unstaged from the changes list (#12923)
- The application icon shows the count of unread finished tasks, and a new flat icon replaces the old one (#12922, #12897)
- New "Clear blue" and "Tea green" colour schemes; theme packs can declare density and corner radius (#12932, #12513)
- The icon rail has a New session button; clicking the folder mark in the title bar opens the project folder (#12891, #12857, #12288 by @keeyangyy)
- File links in a conversation open in the workbench, and the file menu can add a file or folder to the conversation (#12910, #12877)
- Remote machines are gathered into one collapsible row, and the levels of the session tree are easier to tell apart (#12878, #12905)
- Esc must be pressed a second time to stop a running turn (#12859)
- Extension surfaces support style fields, editable drafts, map-versus-dashboard views and non-blocking actions (#12830, #12854, #12876, #12896)
- Installed packages can be searched by capability, show their contribution types, copy their invocation, and the install preview shows the resolved commit (#12065, #12117, #12070, #12075, #12098)
- You can view a sub-agent's skill declarations and search an MCP server's tool list (#12102, #12085)
- WSL distributions are discovered and one of them is probed (#12595)
- The phone page can be added to the home screen; paired phones survive a restart, with a switch in settings (#12591, #12440 by @keeyangyy)
- Linux arm64 .deb and .rpm packages are published (#12914)
- Local stdio MCP servers receive the working directory and the host's read-only state (#12967)
- The tool catalogue refreshes automatically when an MCP server adds or removes tools at runtime and sends a notification (#12138 by @boscocp)
- The host's check of changed turns can be turned off (#12860)
- Right-to-left text blocks are displayed in their own direction (#12118 by @xxoingr)
- The workbench browser-tab menu gains "Close browser tabs to the right", reachable by keyboard (#12557 by @SivanCola)

## Changed

- The Versions page keeps only the latest few earlier versions and folds the rest behind a button (#12982)
- Session lists use single-line ellipsis everywhere, and bulk selection moved to the "This machine" more menu (#12935 by @SivanCola)
- The desktop sidebar uses divider bars for its actions, and the brand mark is the official wordmark throughout (#12918, #12936)
- Computer use now runs on the CUA Driver (#12937)
- The "Execution" block in a conversation is a faint single line, and its header sticks to the top when expanded (#12954, #12944)
- The session title in the title bar sits next to the project name, and the branch button's hover shape matches its neighbours (#12955, #12971)
- The model list keeps only the settings page's own scrollbar, and the display-alias input follows the theme (#12979)
- Installed skills are grouped by source (#12329 by @KHG420)

## Fixed

- Folded user messages no longer vanish entirely when compaction cannot get a summary (#12963)
- The context-usage figure now uses the same number the compaction trigger uses, instead of reading lower than the provider reports (#12991, #12988)
- On Windows, clicking a task-completed notification brings the window to the front, and the click path is logged (#12907, #12956)
- Closing a browser tab no longer reads content the kernel never sends (#12886)
- A question you have started answering no longer times out and is skipped (#12884 by @par73e)
- A turn in progress is kept when the runtime is rebuilt or a turn-end event is lost (#11735 by @jf200s)
- Saving settings now reports success, not applied, and failure separately, and a failure can be retried (#12350 by @KHG420)
- The undo entry is restored from the backend, and an expired-undo state is kept (#11589 by @Guan0923)
- Unsaved file drafts in the workbench are kept (#12898 by @XTLine)
- Context usage refreshes immediately after switching model settings (#12871 by @xlyy1)
- Cost is shown in the wallet's currency, and the folder picker can list hidden folders (#12874)
- On Windows, when the Git Bash probe hangs it is retried once, and the fallback shell path is shown correctly (#12887)
- When only /skill-name is sent, history records exactly what you typed (#12890)
- Duplicate MCP tool names are refused, and the original identifier stays the same on every path (#12889, #12893, #12892)
- Sub-agent status frames are no longer lost when the client falls behind (#12888)
- File preview checks that the target may be accessed, and passes through the PreToolUse hook first (#12115 by @Guan0923)
- A failed memory save is rolled back, and a migrated memory repairs its index when changed again (#12938, #12939, #12940)


The Studio release page lists the same changes in Chinese and English: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases/tag/studio-v2.39.0

name: Reasonix Studio v2.40.0
body:
本版本修复工作区「+」无法点击等问题，新增回合叙述设置，并让更新日志支持中英文切换。

## 新增

- 反馈对话框新增「截取当前窗口」：只在你点按钮时截一次，截图以可删除的缩略图加入附件，不会自动发送。关联 #11965 fixed in #13033。
- 侧边栏的会话列表数据现在带「最后活动时间」，可按最近使用排序或显示相对时间。关联 #12011 fixed in #12995。
- 子代理因另一个子代理占着要写的路径而排队时，现在会说明在等谁、是否因为双方都没声明 write_paths（按整个工作区处理）。关联 #12052。
- 主题包新增 `shadowFloat`，可改菜单、弹出层和对话框的投影；不设则保持内置阴影。关联 #12063 fixed in #12996。
- 图表在数据不多时，会在柱顶和折线数据点旁直接标出数值；数据多到放不下时自动不画，悬停读数仍然可用。关联 #12291。
- 侧栏里的项目现在可以拖动排序：按住项目行拖到目标位置，上沿或下沿的线指示落点；顺序保存在内核里。关联 #12300。
- 每轮结束时的「耗时」行现在同时写出这一轮的开始时间（当天只显示时分，其他日子带日期），重新载入会话后仍然保留。关联 #12728 fixed in #12994。
- 设置 > 账号新增「导出与导入配置」：无需账号，加密导出成文件、换机器时逐项导入；密钥默认不导出，必须设口令。关联 #12736。
- 设置 → 会话新增「回合间叙述」：选「详细」后，模型会在每批工具调用之间用三四行说明拿到了什么、下一步做什么；默认「简短」，行为不变。关联 #12788 fixed in #13101。
- 项目右键菜单新增「用 … 打开」：文件管理器之外，可用本机已安装的 VS Code、Cursor、IntelliJ IDEA、系统终端打开项目文件夹。关联 #12858。
- 工作台文件面板里新增「提交历史」：展开后按提交图谱列出所有分支最近的提交，带分支和标签。关联 #12913 fixed in #13028。
- 设置 → 外观新增「1.x 旧会话」开关，可把迁移来的 1.x 会话从侧栏隐藏；默认显示，不删除，搜索和已打开的不受影响。关联 #12964 fixed in #13097。
- 终端界面的 `/theme` 现在打开选择器：光标移到哪一行就即时预览，Enter 保留，Esc 还原；`/theme list` 仍列出名称。关联 #12985 fixed in #12999。
- 上下文超过压缩阈值而无内容可折叠时，现在会说明由什么占用（按类别和最大几项），不再只说「无需压缩」。关联 #13013。
- 本机 stdio MCP 服务器现在会在 `_meta["io.reasonix/writableRoots"]` 里收到你额外允许写入的目录；远程服务器不会收到。关联 #13053。
- 首次启动的设置页新增「稍后再说」：可先进入主界面，输入框上方会提示「去连接」；只对本次启动有效，下次仍会提示。关联 #13065 fixed in #13084。
- 底部「生成速度」详情新增「首字时间」（从发出请求到首个输出，由内核计时），并改为与「上下文详情」一致的行式样式。关联 #13075 fixed in #13089。
- 添加项目后会自动选中该项目并打开一个新会话（不会替你发送任何消息），无论是点「打开或新建项目」、首次提示里的按钮还是拖入文件夹。关联 #13076 fixed in #13088。
- 对话区右下角新增「回到顶部 / 跳到最新」悬浮按钮（距端不足 48px 或无需滚动时隐藏），优先跳到最近的展开块，取代原「回到最新」。关联 #13077 fixed in #13091。
- 版本页的更新内容可以在中文和英文之间切换，默认跟随界面语言；之后每个版本的发布说明都附带英文。关联 #13081。

## 变更

- 左侧图标栏和侧栏的「文件」按钮现在是开关：文件面板已展开时再点一次就收起，在别处关掉后再点会重新展开。关联 #12925 fixed in #12997。
- 撰写框的模型菜单里，服务商标题更醒目、模型行缩进，并新增按服务商的筛选标签（可多选、可清除，选择会记住）。关联 #12926。
- 应用、任务栏/Dock、启动器和托盘图标恢复为黑金配色。关联 #13004 by @SivanCola。
- 对话里的图片、输入框里待发的图片和工具截图共用一个查看器：点击放大原图，Esc 退出，焦点回到缩略图。关联 #13006 fixed in #13022、#13010 fixed in #13022。
- 设置侧栏的选中项不再带强调色、边框和左侧竖条，只是底色变深；分区标题比选项更轻，层级更清楚。关联 #13045 fixed in #13050、#13046 fixed in #13050。
- 去掉顶栏的「浏览器」按钮：「工作台」标签是唯一入口，没有运行中的网页时显示「文件 / 改动 / 浏览器」启动页，不再直接开一个空白页。关联 #13067 fixed in #13095。
- 会话行不再在悬停时显示「归档」「删除」两个小图标，界面更简洁；这两个操作仍在右键菜单里，Delete 键也照常可用。关联 #13068 fixed in #13079。

## 修复

- 模型起草提交说明失败时，提交卡片仍列出暂存的文件，输入框留空并说明原因，可以手动填写后提交。关联 #12747 fixed in #12923 and #13005。
- 上下文用量改为以服务商回报的大小加上之后新增的内容为准，不再取本地估算和回报中较大的一个，估算偏大时不再虚高。关联 #12988 fixed in #12991 and #13018。
- 只读的 `find ... -exec wc/grep/cat/stat ...` 不再被当成写入：它不会占用工作区写入租约，也就不会再和另一个会话正在写的文件冲突。关联 #12993 fixed in #13003。
- 模型退化成「很多句不重复的短句」（如 go. / End. / I wait.）时，重复输出检测现在也会提示；以前只认字节完全相同的循环。关联 #13001 fixed in #13008。
- 子代理浮层里每个子代理现在显示自己的任务标题（来自任务描述的首行，过长截断，悬停看全文），并行的子代理不再都只写「task」。关联 #13002 fixed in #13014。
- 切换长会话时不再弹出「扩展界面恢复失败」；只有确实丢了扩展界面才提示一次，读不出历史才报错。关联 #13011 fixed in #13019。
- 运行分析的信号轨里挨得太近的标记合并成一个带数量的标记，点开列出明细，不再排成很长的竖列。关联 #13034 fixed in #13040。
- 修复项目行上“…”按钮只有四个角能点、点中间没有反应的问题：行内的数量徽标淡出后仍然盖在按钮上，现在不再拦截鼠标。关联 #13036 fixed in #13042、#13038。
- 侧栏会话筛选旁的放大镜现在是真正的开关：再点一次会收起搜索框，不再重播弹出动画。关联 #13041 fixed in #13049。
- 侧栏「这台机器」行上打开或新建项目文件夹的“＋”按钮现在始终可见，不再要把鼠标移到行上才出现。关联 #13043 fixed in #13074、#13072。
- 修复输入框里打开分支菜单时，悬停提示卡没有收起、与菜单叠成两层阴影的问题。关联 #13044 fixed in #13054。
- 重新载入会话时读取状态失败而弹出的红色提示，在之后同一读取成功时会自动消失，不用再手动点“知道了”。关联 #13047。
- 设置没生效、链接打不开等不阻断发送的失败，改为右下角的小提示（最多 3 条，点“知道了”才消失），可一键“报告此问题”。关联 #13047、#13048。
- 扩展界面、MCP 目录和改动文件三处读取遇到缺失的列表字段时按空列表处理，不再弹出「Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')」。关联 #13055。
- 分支列表、事件回放和待发队列在为空时现在返回空列表而不是 null，页面不再因此在读取时出错。关联 #13055。
- 报错条与右下角提示的「报告此问题」现在会把页面自身错误的名称和出错位置（仅文件名与行列号）一并填进反馈草稿，便于定位。关联 #13055。
- 输入框下的红色提示若是页面自身的程序错误（如“Cannot read properties of undefined”），现在会把调用栈写进控制台，便于定位。关联 #13055。
- 手机远控页上传较大的图片或文件时，不再把连接弄断：过大的内容会在手机上直接提示并留在原处，其他操作照常。关联 #13056。
- 手机远控页现在可以上传较大的图片和文件：内容拆成多条消息发送，电脑端收齐后一次处理（最大 16 MB）；旧版电脑端仍提示太大。关联 #13056。
- 修复写入会话临时目录等工作区外位置时反复弹出“检查点记录失败”的提示：这类写入不在检查点范围内，改为记为覆盖缺口。关联 #13060 fixed in #13063。
- 修复 MCP 服务器启动或重连失败时内核崩溃退出的问题：失败现在只会让这个服务器不可用，不会影响其他功能。关联 #13086 fixed in #13090。
- 修复部分 Windows 电脑上界面图片（如左上角字标）显示为破损图片的一个可能原因：页面文件的类型不再受注册表里别的程序设置的影响。关联 #13094。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This release fixes the unclickable workspace "+" button, adds a turn-narration setting, and lets the changelog switch between Chinese and English.

## New

- The feedback dialog gains "Capture this window": it takes one picture of the app window only when you click, adds it as a removable thumbnail, and never sends it on its own. Refs #11965 fixed in #13033.
- The session tree now carries each conversation's last-activity time, so a list can sort by recency or show a relative time. Refs #12011 fixed in #12995.
- A sub-agent queued behind another's write claim now says whose claim it waits on, and whether neither declared write_paths (each treated as writing the whole workspace). Refs #12052.
- Theme packs gain `shadowFloat`, the shadow menus, popovers and dialogs cast; unset keeps the built-in one. Refs #12063 fixed in #12996.
- Charts now write each value beside its bar or line point while the plot is sparse, and draw none when there are too many marks to read; hover readout is unchanged. Refs #12291.
- Projects in the sidebar can now be reordered by dragging a row; a line on the target's top or bottom edge shows where it lands, and the order is kept by the kernel. Refs #12300.
- The "Worked for" line at the end of a turn now also says when the turn began (time of day for today, with the date for another day), and it survives reopening the session. Refs #12728 fixed in #12994.
- Settings > Account gains "Export and import config": no account needed; export an encrypted file and import it item by item elsewhere. Keys off by default; a passphrase is required. Refs #12736.
- Settings → Session gains "Narration between tool calls": Detailed asks the model for three or four lines between batches of tool calls; Brief, the default, changes nothing. Refs #12788 fixed in #13101.
- The project menu gains "Open with …": besides the file manager, open a project folder in the VS Code, Cursor, IntelliJ IDEA or system terminal this machine has installed. Refs #12858.
- The workbench explorer gains a "Commit history" section: opened, it lists the newest commits of every branch as a graph, with branches and tags. Refs #12913 fixed in #13028.
- Settings → Appearance gains a "Sessions from 1.x" switch to hide migrated 1.x sessions from the sidebar; shown by default, nothing is deleted. Refs #12964 fixed in #13097.
- In the terminal UI, `/theme` now opens a picker that previews each row as you move, keeps it on Enter and restores the original on Esc; `/theme list` still prints the names. Refs #12985 fixed in #12999.
- When the context is over the compaction threshold with nothing to fold, a notice now says what holds the tokens, by class and largest items. Refs #13013.
- Local stdio MCP servers now receive the extra folders you allowed tools to write in `_meta["io.reasonix/writableRoots"]`; remote ones do not. Refs #13053.
- First-run setup gains "Not now": open the workbench first, with a note above the input box leading back to setup; this launch only, offered again next time. Refs #13065 fixed in #13084.
- The bottom "Generation speed" detail gains "Time to first token" (request sent to first output, timed by the kernel) and now uses the same row layout as the context detail. Refs #13075 fixed in #13089.
- Adding a project now selects it and opens a new session in it (nothing is sent for you), whether through "Open or create project", the first-run prompt or a folder drop. Refs #13076 fixed in #13088.
- New floating "Back to top" / "Jump to latest" buttons in the conversation (hidden near an end or when nothing scrolls) land on the nearest expanded block first. Refs #13077 fixed in #13091.
- The Versions page can switch a release's notes between Chinese and English, following the interface language by default; every release's notes now carry English. Refs #13081.

## Changed

- The Files button in the rail and sidebar now toggles: pressed while the files panel is open it folds it, and it reopens after the panel was closed elsewhere. Refs #12925 fixed in #12997.
- The composer's model menu now sets provider headings apart, indents the models, and adds multi-select provider chips that are remembered. Refs #12926.
- Restore the black-and-gold application, taskbar/Dock, launcher and tray icons. Refs #13004 by @SivanCola.
- Sent pictures, pictures waiting in the composer and tool screenshots share one viewer: open the original, Esc to leave, focus returns. Refs #13006 fixed in #13022, #13010 fixed in #13022.
- The Settings sidebar's selected row no longer carries the accent colour, outline and edge bar, only a deeper fill; section titles are lighter than the items under them. Refs #13045 fixed in #13050, #13046 fixed in #13050.
- The title-bar Browser button is gone: the Workbench tab is the one way in, and with nothing running it shows the Files / Changes / Browser start page instead of opening a blank page. Refs #13067 fixed in #13095.
- Session rows no longer show the hover Archive and Delete icons; both stay in the right-click menu, and the Delete key still works. Refs #13068 fixed in #13079.

## Fixed

- When the model cannot draft a commit message, the commit card still lists the staged files and says why; type the message and commit. Refs #12747 fixed in #12923 and #13005.
- The context gauge now reads the provider's reported size plus what grew since, instead of the larger of that and the local estimate, so an estimate running high no longer inflates it. Refs #12988 fixed in #12991 and #13018.
- A read-only `find ... -exec wc/grep/cat/stat ...` is no longer treated as a write, so it does not claim the workspace write lease or collide with another session's edit. Refs #12993 fixed in #13003.
- The repeated-output guard now also flags a stream that collapses to a few tiny lines in no fixed order; before it only saw byte-identical loops. Refs #13001 fixed in #13008.
- Each sub-agent in the sub-agents popover now shows its own task title (the first line of its description, cut to fit, full text on hover), so parallel ones no longer all read "task". Refs #13002 fixed in #13014.
- Switching to a long session no longer shows "could not restore extension surfaces"; you hear once only if a surface was dropped. Refs #13011 fixed in #13019.
- On the run-analysis signal rail, marks too close together now share one counted marker that opens a list, instead of stacking into a tall column. Refs #13034 fixed in #13040.
- Fixed the project row's "…" button answering only at its corners: the faded count badge kept sitting over it and taking the click; it no longer takes the pointer. Refs #13036 fixed in #13042, #13038.
- The magnifier beside the session filters is now a real toggle: pressing it again closes the find box instead of replaying its opening animation. Refs #13041 fixed in #13049.
- The "+" that opens or creates a project folder on the sidebar's "This machine" row is now always visible instead of appearing only when the row is hovered. Refs #13043 fixed in #13074, #13072.
- Fixed the branch hover card staying on screen under the branch menu and stacking a second shadow. Refs #13044 fixed in #13054.
- The red notice raised when reading the session status fails on reload now clears itself when that read next succeeds, instead of waiting for "Got it". Refs #13047.
- Failures that do not block sending now show as corner notices (three at most, dismissed only by you) with "Report this problem". Refs #13047, #13048.
- The extension-surface, MCP catalog and changed-files reads treat a missing list as empty instead of raising "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')". Refs #13055.
- The branch list, event replay and queue now answer an empty list instead of null when they are empty, so the page no longer fails reading them. Refs #13055.
- The "Report this problem" entry on error bars and corner notices now also writes a page defect's error name and where it came from (file name and line only) into the feedback draft. Refs #13055.
- A red notice under the composer that comes from a defect of the page itself (for example "Cannot read properties of undefined") now also logs its stack to the console. Refs #13055.
- Uploading a large image or file from the phone remote page no longer drops the connection: an oversized request is refused on the phone with a clear message and the link keeps working. Refs #13056.
- The phone remote page can now upload larger images and files, sent as several messages and handled once the desktop has them all (up to 16 MB). Refs #13056.
- Fixed the repeated "Checkpoint recording failed" warning for writes outside the workspace, such as the session temp folder: they are now a coverage gap, not a failure. Refs #13060 fixed in #13063.
- Fixed the kernel crashing when an MCP server fails to launch or reconnect: a failed server now only becomes unavailable, nothing else is affected. Refs #13086 fixed in #13090.
- Fixed one likely cause of broken images (such as the sidebar wordmark) on some Windows machines: the page's file types no longer follow other programs' registry entries. Refs #13094.

name: Reasonix Studio v2.39.0
body:
本版加入会话行双击重命名、没有模型服务也能启动、磁盘空间不足提醒和扩展界面的地图与仪表盘，并整理侧边栏与对话的显示细节。

## 新增

- 双击侧边栏会话行就地重命名；重命名对话框可以按需自动起标题 (#12977, #11591 by @Guan0923)
- 没有配置任何模型服务也能启动，直接打开连接引导 (#12966)
- 项目或会话所在磁盘快满时发出提醒，默认开启，只提醒不清理文件 (#12960)
- 终端界面向终端报告工作中、等待你、已完成的状态 (#12976)
- 已完成的会话可以在「进行中」列表里多留一段时间，默认关闭 (#12957)
- 侧边栏标出保存在 1.x 里的会话，终端恢复列表标出未查看的会话 (#12405 by @keeyangyy, #12587)
- 用 / 调用技能时显示为紧凑的技能块；工具调用的 JSON 输入带语法着色 (#12972, #12969)
- 变更列表里可以暂存和取消暂存文件 (#12923)
- 应用图标显示未读的任务完成数，并换成扁平的新图标 (#12922 by @KHG420, #12897)
- 新增「清白蓝」「茶绿」配色，主题包可以声明密度和圆角 (#12932 by @SivanCola, #12513 by @f1shsmell)
- 图标栏有新建会话按钮；点标题栏的文件夹标记可以打开项目文件夹 (#12891, #12857, #12288 by @keeyangyy)
- 对话里的文件链接可以在工作台打开；文件菜单可以把文件或文件夹加入对话 (#12910 by @KHG420, #12877)
- 远程机器收进一个可折叠的行，会话树各层级更容易分清 (#12878, #12905)
- 第二次按 Esc 才会停止正在运行的回合 (#12859)
- 扩展界面支持样式字段、可编辑草稿、地图对比仪表盘和非阻塞动作 (#12830, #12854, #12876, #12896)
- 已安装的包可以按功能搜索、显示贡献类型、复制调用方式，安装预览显示解析出的提交 (#12065 by @KHG420, #12117 by @KHG420, #12070 by @KHG420, #12075 by @KHG420, #12098 by @KHG420)
- 可以查看子代理的技能声明，并搜索 MCP 服务器的工具清单 (#12102 by @KHG420, #12085 by @KHG420)
- 发现 WSL 发行版并探测其中一个 (#12595)
- 手机页可以添加到主屏幕；已配对的手机在重启后保留，设置里有开关 (#12591, #12440 by @keeyangyy)
- 发布 Linux arm64 的 .deb 和 .rpm 安装包 (#12914)
- 本机 stdio 的 MCP 服务器能收到工作目录和宿主的只读状态 (#12967)
- MCP 服务器在运行中增删工具并发出通知时，工具目录会自动刷新 (#12138 by @boscocp)
- 可以关闭宿主对已改动回合的检查 (#12860)
- 从右到左的文字块按自身方向显示 (#12118 by @xxoingr)
- 工作台浏览器标签菜单新增「关闭右侧浏览器标签」，可用键盘打开 (#12557 by @SivanCola)

## 变更

- 版本页只保留最新的几个早期版本，其余折叠到一个按钮后 (#12982)
- 会话列表统一为单行省略，批量选择入口移到「这台机器」的更多菜单 (#12935 by @SivanCola)
- 桌面侧栏统一用分隔条操作；品牌标识统一为正式字标 (#12918 by @SivanCola, #12936 by @SivanCola)
- 计算机操作改用 CUA Driver (#12937)
- 对话里的「执行过程」改成淡色一行，展开后的头部会吸在顶部 (#12954, #12944)
- 标题栏的会话标题紧挨项目名；分支按钮悬停的形状与相邻按钮一致 (#12955, #12971)
- 模型列表只留设置页的一条滚动条，显示别名输入框跟随主题 (#12979)
- 已安装的技能按来源分组 (#12329 by @KHG420)

## 修复

- 压缩拿不到摘要时，被折叠的用户消息不再整段消失 (#12963)
- 上下文占用的显示改为和触发压缩时用的数字一致，不再比服务商回报的偏小 (#12991, #12988 fixed in #12991)
- Windows 上点任务完成通知会把窗口带到前台，点击过程写入日志 (#12907, #12956)
- 关闭浏览器标签时不再读取内核不会发送的内容 (#12886)
- 你已经开始作答的提问不再超时跳过 (#12884 by @par73e)
- 运行时重建或回合结束事件丢失后，仍保留正在进行的回合 (#11735 by @jf200s)
- 保存设置的结果区分成功、未应用和失败，失败后可以重试 (#12350 by @KHG420)
- 撤销入口从后端恢复，撤销失效状态会保存下来 (#11589 by @Guan0923)
- 工作台里未保存的文件草稿会被保留 (#12898 by @XTLine)
- 切换模型设置后上下文占用立即刷新 (#12871 by @xlyy1)
- 费用按钱包的币种显示，文件夹选择器能列出隐藏文件夹 (#12874)
- Windows 上 Git Bash 探测挂起时重试一次，并正确显示回退用的终端路径 (#12887)
- 只发 /技能名 时，历史里记录的是你输入的原文 (#12890)
- MCP 工具重名会被拒绝，原始标识在各条路径里保持一致 (#12889 by @XTLine, #12893 by @XTLine, #12892 by @XTLine)
- 子代理状态帧在客户端落后时不再丢失 (#12888)
- 文件预览会先检查目标是否允许访问，并先经过 PreToolUse 钩子 (#12115 by @Guan0923)
- 记忆保存失败时会撤回，迁移过的记忆再次修改时会修复索引 (#12938 by @chuiwenwei, #12939 by @chuiwenwei, #12940 by @chuiwenwei)

## English

This release adds double-click rename for sessions, starting without any model service, a low-disk-space warning and maps and dashboards in extension surfaces, and tidies the sidebar and conversation display.

## New

- Double-click a session row in the sidebar to rename it in place; the rename dialog can generate a title on request (#12977, #11591 by @Guan0923)
- Reasonix starts without any model service configured and opens the connection guide directly (#12966)
- A warning appears when the disk holding a project or session is nearly full; on by default, it only warns and never deletes files (#12960)
- The terminal UI reports working, waiting-for-you and finished states to the terminal (#12976)
- A finished session can stay in the Running list for a chosen time; off by default (#12957)
- The sidebar marks sessions stored by 1.x, and the terminal resume list marks sessions you have not viewed (#12405, #12587)
- A skill invoked with / shows as a compact skill block, and the JSON input of tool calls is syntax-coloured (#12972, #12969)
- Files can be staged and unstaged from the changes list (#12923)
- The application icon shows the count of unread finished tasks, and a new flat icon replaces the old one (#12922, #12897)
- New "Clear blue" and "Tea green" colour schemes; theme packs can declare density and corner radius (#12932, #12513)
- The icon rail has a New session button; clicking the folder mark in the title bar opens the project folder (#12891, #12857, #12288 by @keeyangyy)
- File links in a conversation open in the workbench, and the file menu can add a file or folder to the conversation (#12910, #12877)
- Remote machines are gathered into one collapsible row, and the levels of the session tree are easier to tell apart (#12878, #12905)
- Esc must be pressed a second time to stop a running turn (#12859)
- Extension surfaces support style fields, editable drafts, map-versus-dashboard views and non-blocking actions (#12830, #12854, #12876, #12896)
- Installed packages can be searched by capability, show their contribution types, copy their invocation, and the install preview shows the resolved commit (#12065, #12117, #12070, #12075, #12098)
- You can view a sub-agent's skill declarations and search an MCP server's tool list (#12102, #12085)
- WSL distributions are discovered and one of them is probed (#12595)
- The phone page can be added to the home screen; paired phones survive a restart, with a switch in settings (#12591, #12440 by @keeyangyy)
- Linux arm64 .deb and .rpm packages are published (#12914)
- Local stdio MCP servers receive the working directory and the host's read-only state (#12967)
- The tool catalogue refreshes automatically when an MCP server adds or removes tools at runtime and sends a notification (#12138 by @boscocp)
- The host's check of changed turns can be turned off (#12860)
- Right-to-left text blocks are displayed in their own direction (#12118 by @xxoingr)
- The workbench browser-tab menu gains "Close browser tabs to the right", reachable by keyboard (#12557 by @SivanCola)

## Changed

- The Versions page keeps only the latest few earlier versions and folds the rest behind a button (#12982)
- Session lists use single-line ellipsis everywhere, and bulk selection moved to the "This machine" more menu (#12935 by @SivanCola)
- The desktop sidebar uses divider bars for its actions, and the brand mark is the official wordmark throughout (#12918, #12936)
- Computer use now runs on the CUA Driver (#12937)
- The "Execution" block in a conversation is a faint single line, and its header sticks to the top when expanded (#12954, #12944)
- The session title in the title bar sits next to the project name, and the branch button's hover shape matches its neighbours (#12955, #12971)
- The model list keeps only the settings page's own scrollbar, and the display-alias input follows the theme (#12979)
- Installed skills are grouped by source (#12329 by @KHG420)

## Fixed

- Folded user messages no longer vanish entirely when compaction cannot get a summary (#12963)
- The context-usage figure now uses the same number the compaction trigger uses, instead of reading lower than the provider reports (#12991, #12988)
- On Windows, clicking a task-completed notification brings the window to the front, and the click path is logged (#12907, #12956)
- Closing a browser tab no longer reads content the kernel never sends (#12886)
- A question you have started answering no longer times out and is skipped (#12884 by @par73e)
- A turn in progress is kept when the runtime is rebuilt or a turn-end event is lost (#11735 by @jf200s)
- Saving settings now reports success, not applied, and failure separately, and a failure can be retried (#12350 by @KHG420)
- The undo entry is restored from the backend, and an expired-undo state is kept (#11589 by @Guan0923)
- Unsaved file drafts in the workbench are kept (#12898 by @XTLine)
- Context usage refreshes immediately after switching model settings (#12871 by @xlyy1)
- Cost is shown in the wallet's currency, and the folder picker can list hidden folders (#12874)
- On Windows, when the Git Bash probe hangs it is retried once, and the fallback shell path is shown correctly (#12887)
- When only /skill-name is sent, history records exactly what you typed (#12890)
- Duplicate MCP tool names are refused, and the original identifier stays the same on every path (#12889, #12893, #12892)
- Sub-agent status frames are no longer lost when the client falls behind (#12888)
- File preview checks that the target may be accessed, and passes through the PreToolUse hook first (#12115 by @Guan0923)
- A failed memory save is rolled back, and a migrated memory repairs its index when changed again (#12938, #12939, #12940)

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@Guan0923、@keeyangyy、@KHG420、@SivanCola、@f1shsmell、@boscocp、@xxoingr、@par73e、@jf200s、@XTLine、@xlyy1、@chuiwenwei

## What's Changed
* fix(studio): keep the sidebar toggle clickable in the desktop shell by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12855
* feat(studio): open the project folder from the chrome folder mark by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12857
* feat(studio): open the project folder from the chrome folder mark by @keeyangyy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12288

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

**macOS** builds are signed with a Developer ID and notarized, so no quarantine attribute needs clearing. On **Windows** the window, kernel and installer are Authenticode-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate. On **Linux**, install the `.deb` on Debian-based systems and the `.rpm` on Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE and similar (`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`). Use the amd64 file on x86_64 and the arm64 file on aarch64.

All three platforms self-update: the Linux `.deb` through its own package (the `.rpm` has no self-update yet, so download the new package by hand), Windows by running the next installer, and macOS by replacing its own bundle.

name: Caveman 4.0.1
body:
Caveman 4.0.1 fixes what turned up in the first hours of 4.0.0: a Windows uninstall bug, a sync that could never catch up, and problems on OpenCode 2 and Pi.

### Windows

- `caveman off --all` left the Caveman Blocks hook in Claude Code's settings, and every `caveman setup` added another copy. Blocks v0.1.0-rc.5 installs its binary as `.exe`, recognises the entries rc.4 wrote, and replaces them on the next `caveman setup`.
- An npm `.cmd` shim that forwards to a native `.exe` launches again.
- Hook child processes no longer flash a console window.

### Sync

- `caveman sync` uploads a large backlog of local spans in batches. Before, a store over the 16 MiB import cap failed with "Request body exceeds configured limit" on every retry.
- The `ExperimentalWarning: SQLite` line is gone.
- Known issue: the practice-findings part of `caveman sync` still reports "Request rejected". That is a Caveman Cloud bug and needs no CLI update once Cloud is fixed.

### OpenCode

- On OpenCode 2, a subagent spawn reset the mode for every session, undoing "stop caveman" and `/ultracave`. Subagent sessions no longer touch the mode.
- The "provider is not routed" warning reads where a provider actually sends requests.

### Pi

- `caveman wrap pi` after `caveman enable pi` loaded the extension twice and Pi exited 1.
- Routing a model no longer resets the thinking level (`--thinking high` stayed only until session start).
- Works with Pi 1.1+ custom-message turns.
- `@caveman-ai/pi` 0.3.1: the npm package now reads Caveman 4's config and port.

### Claude Code and Codex

- The prompt hook gives up after 2 seconds when the host sends no complete payload, like the other hooks.
- Blocks honors `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and `CODEX_HOME`; it used to write the hook into `~/.claude` regardless.
- `caveman status` no longer says "account refresh offline" after signing in to a different account.

### Smaller fixes

- Proxy: one key sent in both auth headers keeps its bearer; a Termux-built proxy is recognised as Caveman's own.
- Memory: longer retry on SQLite contention.
- `/caveman-compress` asks for a file path instead of improvising on pasted text, and says that the file goes to your model provider.
- Tested agent pins moved to current Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Kilo and Qwen releases.

### Versions

- `@caveman-ai/cli` 4.0.0 → 4.0.1, binaries `bin-v4.0.0` → `bin-v4.0.1`, `@caveman-ai/pi` 0.3.0 → 0.3.1, Blocks v0.1.0-rc.4 → v0.1.0-rc.5.

### Companion releases

- [Signed binaries, module index and container: `bin-v4.0.1`](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman/releases/tag/bin-v4.0.1)
- [npm CLI: `@caveman-ai/cli@4.0.1`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@caveman-ai/cli/v/4.0.1)
- [npm Pi extension: `@caveman-ai/pi@0.3.1`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@caveman-ai/pi/v/0.3.1)

name: Caveman 4.0.0
body:
Caveman 4.0.0 makes `npx @caveman-ai/cli` the one install, adds Auto routing through Caveman Cloud on top of the local proxy, and ships Caveman Blocks as a module.

### One command to install

- `npx @caveman-ai/cli` opens a one-screen setup. It finds your coding agents and their logins (every Claude Code profile), shows what it will change, applies on Enter, then offers to start the agent. Without a terminal it applies only with `--yes`.
- `install.sh` and `install.ps1` end in the same setup, pinned to the CLI this release ships.
- `caveman on|off` switches modules from a registry. The module index (`modules.json`) is listed in the signed checksum manifest of the binary release, and the CLI refuses an index that manifest does not list. A module lockfile records what is installed.
- New commands: `caveman stop`, a status grid, an offline `caveman doctor`, `caveman providers add|remove|login|local` and `caveman providers cloud on|off`.
- One config home: `~/.caveman/cloud.json`. Older config migrates once, without races, and the telemetry opt-out carries over.
- Sign-in uses the shared device flow. It refuses plain-HTTP Clouds other than this machine.

### Auto routing (signed in to Caveman Cloud)

- `caveman-auto` shows up in the Claude Code and OpenCode model pickers with a 1M context window. Routing applies only to Auto, and that includes Claude Pro/Max logins and ChatGPT logins (Codex, OpenCode).
- For each routable request the proxy asks Cloud's route stage for a model and effort (contracts `route-ask-v1`) and picks from the providers you set up. If the key is refused or a billing limit is hit, the request goes through unrouted and `caveman status` says why.
- Translators between Messages, Chat Completions and Responses cover all nine directions, so Claude Code can run on Responses hosts such as the ChatGPT plan.
- A signed-in runtime sends `runtime/v1` event batches to Cloud and respects the telemetry opt-out.

### Cache

- The proxy keeps the Anthropic prompt cache warm while a session is paused. Warm timing comes from measured return times, at most two warms run at once, and `caveman stats` lists every warm.
- A session stays on its model across Cloud pauses and transient failures, so a model switch doesn't rewrite the cached prefix.

### Caveman Blocks

- The binary release mirrors `caveman-ai/blocks` v0.1.0-rc.4 (pinned by the digest of its checksum list). Each Blocks binary is republished under the same signed manifest as the other binaries. Blocks usage counts fall under the same telemetry notice and opt-out as Caveman's.

### Catalog

- Adds Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna.

### Versions

- `@caveman-ai/cli` goes from 2.1.0 to 4.0.0 to match the product version. Binaries move from `bin-v2.1.0` to `bin-v4.0.0`.
- The `npx github:JuliusBrussee/caveman` installer depends on CLI `^4.0.0`, so `-- --uninstall` runs a CLI that understands what 4.0 wrote.

### Companion releases

- [Signed binaries, module index and container: `bin-v4.0.0`](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman/releases/tag/bin-v4.0.0)

name: Voyager v2.0.0
body:
## ✨ What's New | Feature | Description | By | | --- | --- | --- | | **Write your own plugins** | Describe a change in one sentence, let any AI or coding agent write it, and Voyager checks it before importing. Scaffold with `npx create-voyager-plugin`. | — | | **ChatGPT folders** | Folders inside ChatGPT's own sidebar, with nesting, drag to reorder, multi-select, `f:` search, Activity view and cloud sync. | — | | **21 new official plugins** | For ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek, from a ChatGPT timeline to quote reply, draft auto-save and table copy. All start turned off. | — | | **Saved Library page** | Starred messages and highlights open in their own tab, with the popup's filters, search and cards. | — | | **ChatGPT timeline** _(off by default)_ | Jump between your prompts and star them, as on Gemini and Claude. | — | | **Quote reply** _(off by default)_ | Select text in a ChatGPT, Claude or DeepSeek answer and quote it into your draft. | — | | **Ctrl/⌘+Enter to send** _(off by default)_ | Enter adds a new line on ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek; Ctrl/⌘+Enter sends. | — | | **Draft auto-save** _(off by default)_ | Unsent text on Claude and DeepSeek stays on this device and comes back after a refresh. | — | | **Draft counter** _(off by default)_ | Live character, word or line count above the message box on ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek. | — | | **Reading typography** _(off by default)_ | Answer text size, line height and paragraph spacing on ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek. | DeepSeek: PR #1034 by @ccch1mneyyy | | **DeepSeek table copy and code collapse** _(off by default)_ | Copy tables as Markdown or TSV, and fold long code blocks. | PR #1035, #1036 by @ccch1mneyyy | | **DeepSeek copy thinking** _(off by default)_ | Copy the thinking section of an answer. | — | | **ChatGPT extras** _(off by default)_ | ECharts and WaveDrom diagrams, collapsible long messages, and LaTeX in your own messages. | — | | **Research Pack** _(off by default)_ | Gather Gemini answers with their prompts and sources into one Markdown pack, then copy, download or continue in ChatGPT or Claude. | — | | **More cloud sync** | ChatGPT folders sync on their own; ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek timeline outlines and stars back up to Google Drive. | — | | **Timelines everywhere match Gemini** | ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek timelines get Nodes, Compact and Ruler styles, shortcuts and previews. | — | | **Starred prompts keep their full text** | Cards expand to show it, and search covers it. | — | | **Broken-feature notice** | When a Gemini update breaks a Voyager feature, the popup says so and offers a privacy-safe report link. | — | | **One look for notices** | Toasts and confirmations share one stacked, themed design instead of browser alerts. | — | | **Gemini watermark switch** | Removal now starts off on new installs; updates keep your current setting. | — | ## 🐛 Bug Fixes | Fix | Description | By | | --- | --- | --- | | **Unstarred stays unstarred** | A message you unstarred no longer comes back after cloud sync. | — | | **ChatGPT export** | Long chats export in full again, with progress and Cancel, and code blocks export as code. | — | | **ChatGPT export toolbar** | The export button no longer attaches to unlabeled header controls. | PR #1045 by @MannXo | | **Gemini sidebar** | Loading older chats no longer stalls with folders and draft auto-save on. (closes #1040) | — | | **Safer folders** | Open tabs no longer overwrite each other's folder changes, and a failed read can't wipe your folders. | — | | **Prompt library** | Edits in several tabs, imports and Drive merges keep your order, pins and latest edits. | — | | **Default model** | Works with Gemini's Low, Medium and High thinking options. | — | | **Markdown export** | Keeps every image instead of stopping at 40. | — | | **Opening saved stars** | Starred ChatGPT and DeepSeek messages open on their own site. | — | | **ChatGPT theme** | Voyager follows ChatGPT's light or dark theme instead of the system's. | — | | **After an update** | Open tabs no longer show doubled Voyager panels. | — | | **AI Studio folders** | Deleted folders stay deleted, and folder actions no longer reload the page. | — | | **Drive restore** | Conversation forks are restored too. | — | | **Gemini forks** | Opening a fork no longer reloads the page. | — | | **Response completion notifications** | Turning them on now sticks after you answer the browser's permission prompt. | — | | **Safari release privacy check** | Release tooling handles native paths in privacy checks. | PR #1043 by @Hicod-ghl | --- ## 中文版 ## ✨ 新功能 | 功能 | 说明 | 提交者 | | --- | --- | --- | | **自己写插件** | 用一句话描述想改的地方，交给任意 AI 或编程 Agent 写，Voyager 检查后再导入。可用 `npx create-voyager-plugin` 生成模板。 | — | | **ChatGPT 文件夹** | 在 ChatGPT 自己的侧边栏里分文件夹，支持嵌套、拖拽排序、多选、`f:` 搜索、活动视图和云同步。 | — | | **21 个新的官方插件** | 覆盖 ChatGPT、Claude 和 DeepSeek，从 ChatGPT 时间线到引用回复、草稿自动保存、表格复制。全部默认关闭。 | — | | **收藏库独立页面** | 收藏的消息和高亮在单独的标签页里打开，筛选、搜索和卡片都和弹窗一致。 | — | | **ChatGPT 时间线** _（默认关闭）_ | 在提问之间跳转、收藏提问，和 Gemini、Claude 一样。 | — | | **引用回复** _（默认关闭）_ | 在 ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek 的回答里选中文字，引用进输入框。 | — | | **Ctrl/⌘+Enter 发送** _（默认关闭）_ | 在 ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek 上 Enter 换行，Ctrl/⌘+Enter 发送。 | — | | **草稿自动保存** _（默认关闭）_ | Claude 和 DeepSeek 上没发出去的文字存在本机，刷新后自动放回。 | — | | **输入框字数统计** _（默认关闭）_ | 在 ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek 的输入框上方实时显示字符、词或行数。 | — | | **阅读排版** _（默认关闭）_ | 调整 ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek 回答的字号、行高和段距。 | DeepSeek：PR #1034 by @ccch1mneyyy | | **DeepSeek 表格复制和代码折叠** _（默认关闭）_ | 表格复制为 Markdown 或 TSV，折叠长代码块。 | PR #1035、#1036 by @ccch1mneyyy | | **DeepSeek 复制思考过程** _（默认关闭）_ | 一键复制回答里的思考部分。 | — | | **ChatGPT 新插件** _（默认关闭）_ | ECharts 和 WaveDrom 图表、折叠长消息、自己消息里的 LaTeX。 | — | | **研究资料包** _（默认关闭）_ | 把 Gemini 的回答连同提问和引用来源收进一份 Markdown，可复制、下载，或带到 ChatGPT、Claude 接着聊。 | — | | **云同步覆盖更多** | ChatGPT 文件夹有了自己的云同步；ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek 的时间线大纲和收藏也会备份到 Google Drive。 | — | | **各站时间线向 Gemini 看齐** | ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek 的时间线也有节点、紧凑、刻度三种样式，以及快捷键和预览。 | — | | **收藏的提示词保存全文** | 卡片可以展开看全文，搜索也覆盖全文。 | — | | **功能失效提醒** | Gemini 改版弄坏 Voyager 功能时，弹窗会提示，并给出不含隐私的反馈链接。 | — | | **统一的通知样式** | 提示和确认框统一成一套可堆叠、跟随主题的样式，不再弹浏览器对话框。 | — | | **Gemini 去水印单独开关** | 新安装默认关闭；升级的用户保持原来的设置。 | — | ## 🐛 修复 | 修复 | 说明 | 提交者 | | --- | --- | --- | | **取消的收藏不再复活** | 取消收藏的消息，云同步之后不会再回来。 | — | | **ChatGPT 导出** | 长对话又能完整导出了，有进度和取消按钮，代码块也按代码导出。 | — | | **ChatGPT 导出按钮位置** | 导出按钮不再挂到没有标签的页头按钮上。 | PR #1045 by @MannXo | | **Gemini 侧边栏** | 开着文件夹和草稿自动保存时，加载更早的对话不会再卡住。（关联 #1040） | — | | **文件夹更安全** | 多个标签页不会再互相覆盖文件夹改动，读取失败也不会清空文件夹。 | — | | **提示词库** | 多标签页编辑、导入和 Drive 合并都会保留顺序、置顶和最新改动。 | — | | **默认模型** | 支持 Gemini 新的低、中、高思考档位。 | — | | **Markdown 导出** | 保留全部图片，不再到 40 张就停。 | — | | **打开收藏** | 收藏的 ChatGPT 和 DeepSeek 消息能在各自的网站上打开。 | — | | **ChatGPT 主题** | Voyager 跟随 ChatGPT 自己的深浅色，而不是系统设置。 | — | | **更新之后** | 已经打开的标签页不会再出现两套 Voyager 面板。 | — | | **AI Studio 文件夹** | 删掉的文件夹不会再回来，文件夹操作也不会整页刷新。 | — | | **Drive 恢复** | 对话分支也会一起恢复。 | — | | **Gemini 对话分支** | 打开分支不再刷新整个页面。 | — | | **思考完成通知** | 在浏览器的权限提示里允许后，开关会保持开启。 | — | | **Safari 发版隐私检查** | 发版工具的隐私检查能处理原生路径。 | PR #1043 by @Hicod-ghl | --- ## New Contributors - @Hicod-ghl made their first contribution in PR #1043 - @MannXo made their first contribution in PR #1045 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager/compare/v1.9.0...v2.0.0 ## 📥 Installation
     

Edge users: Voyager is still maintained on Edge Add-ons for users who need Edge on mobile or tablet. If review is delayed, Chrome Web Store and GitHub manual packages remain available.

- **Chrome / Edge / Chromium browsers**: `voyager-chrome-v2.0.0.zip` - **Firefox**: `voyager-firefox-v2.0.0.xpi` - **Safari**: `voyager-v2.0.0.dmg` > Do not use GitHub's auto-generated **Source code (zip/tar.gz)** archives for manual extension installs. Those files are repository source snapshots, not browser-ready extension packages.
🍎 Safari 安装与升级说明 (Safari installation & upgrade) > 🎉 从 v1.6.0 起，Voyager 的核心功能已正式覆盖 Safari。 > Starting with v1.6.0, Voyager's core experience is officially supported on Safari. - 📦 **安装 (Installation)**: 下载并打开 `voyager-v2.0.0.dmg`，按提示安装应用。 Download and open `voyager-v2.0.0.dmg`, then follow the prompts to install the app. - ⚠️ **旧版升级 (Legacy upgrade)**: 如果仍安装着 `Gemini Voyager.app`，请先完成一次 [Safari 迁移步骤](https://voyager.nagi.fun/guide/safari-migration)，避免两个 App 并存。 If `Gemini Voyager.app` is still installed, follow the one-time [Safari migration guide](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/safari-migration) first so the two apps do not conflict. - 🖼️ **图片能力 (Images)**: Image Refinement 水印去除、全尺寸图片下载与聊天导出中的图片提取均已支持。 Image Refinement watermark removal, full-size image downloads, and image extraction in conversation exports are supported. - ☁️ **原生云同步 (Native cloud sync)**: Google Drive 与 iCloud 同步均已接入 Safari 原生层。 Google Drive and iCloud sync are integrated through Safari's native layer. - 🔔 **系统通知 (Notifications)**: Gemini 回复完成后可发送 macOS 通知，并直达对应对话。 macOS can notify you when a Gemini response finishes and open the matching conversation. - 🔄 **自动更新 (Automatic updates)**: 完成这次迁移后，后续版本可通过 Sparkle 自动更新。 After this one-time migration, future versions can update automatically through Sparkle.

name: v5.1.33
body:
**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.13: a busy host gives memory back when its sessions end.** An RPC host serving many sessions used to keep the heap of every session it had run until it exited, so a long day of terminal-heavy work held its peak footprint; it now returns freed heap as sessions drop ([senpi#3240](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3240), [senpi#3221](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3221)). Tool calls through DeepSeek's official API, and gateways that forward to it, stop failing with `400 Invalid schema ... got 'type: null'`, because every tool schema now declares a root `type: "object"` ([senpi#3250](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3250)). The Claude subscription lane runs Claude Code 2.1.296 ([senpi#3258](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3258)), the model catalog is refreshed from the live providers ([senpi#3248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3248)), large eval data cells no longer stall the shared host ([senpi#3206](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3206)), and RPC clients see a scheduled goal continuation and can run it now ([senpi#3208](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3208)). Full notes: [senpi 2026.10.13](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.13).

**Daemon-hosted background tasks keep running when their parent exits or starts a new session.** The parent detaches without aborting their turns. On `/new` or exit, one notice names the old session and the `omo --resume` command to collect results; children stay owned by that session. Local in-process and stdio children retain their shutdown behavior. ([#8517](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8517), [#10018](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10018))

**A child that stops answering no longer hangs a task indefinitely.** Stdio RPC requests have deadlines, and both process runners keep one heartbeat in flight. Three missed ten-second probes end a running child as `child-unresponsive`, preserve its transcript, and name how to inspect and rerun it in `task_output`. The last successful heartbeat appears as `last_seen_at` in the live task snapshot. ([#10017](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10017))

**Resuming a background task no longer waits for a free slot.** When its concurrency group is full, resuming a finished background task now returns at once as pending and sends the follow-up when a slot frees, instead of blocking the call. A second resume of the same task while one is queued is refused, cancelling a queued resume releases nothing it didn't hold, and a fallback retry keeps the latest follow-up prompt. Thanks to @imadal1n. ([#9985](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9985))

**A task child started as its own process never receives its fallback chain after its first prompt.** When the engine answered the capability check only after the chain deadline, the runner still sent `set_retry_fallback` once the first prompt was already out; it now drops the chain at the deadline, and the child keeps the manager's fallback with the usual "no answer" warning. This was the intermittent windows-latest test failure. ([#9582](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9582), [#10087](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10087))

**ulw-execute stops a checkpoint that keeps failing instead of retrying it for days.** After the same failure twice in a row, a third failed attempt, or four hours open, the checkpoint and every checkpoint that depends on it are marked blocked (`[~]`) with the gap left, recorded in the ledger and the final report, and the run moves on to the rest of the plan. A broken test harness gets one repair attempt, and work found while a checkpoint is open is queued after it unless it blocks that checkpoint. ([#10051](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10051))

**Mass research plans its whole collection before it starts instead of one wave at a time.** `mass ulw research` now defines every angle as a harvest, expand and verify chain that passes its findings to the next step through a file, so a fast angle reaches verification while slow ones are still harvesting, and leads that are still open join each cluster of angles as soon as that cluster settles. The mass-ulw and ulw-execute skills no longer say a single node's completion wakes the session; only a finished or paused run does. ([#10049](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10049))

body:
# CC Switch v4.0.12

本版本让「应用」页可以完整管理编程工具：安装、升级、卸载，以及检测安装冲突。同一个工具装了多处时，现在可以直接选择卸载多余的那一处，冲突在 CC Switch 里就能解决；升级前会先检查 Node 版本，新版本要求更高的 Node 时不再显示注定失败的升级按钮；Grok Build 新版的安装方式也能卸载了。另外新增「本地」分组，可以直接添加在本机运行的 Ollama、LM Studio、llama.cpp、vLLM，并新增 Ollama Cloud、Groq、Hugging Face、Vercel AI Gateway 等 14 家云平台的预设。会话日志的后台扫描从每 60 秒一次改为每 10 分钟一次，平时更省资源；打开用量页时按所选间隔扫描，新用量反而显示得更快。界面新增土耳其语（社区翻译）；系统语言不在支持范围内时，首次启动改用英文。还修复了云同步恢复 Skills 失败一次后再也恢复不了、Claude Code 经路由连接 Responses 上游时回复结束后又报错等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.12-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.12-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**「应用」页：安装、升级、卸载、检测安装冲突都齐了。** v4.0.11 加上卸载之后，这一版补齐了剩下的环节。一个工具装了多处时，「诊断安装冲突」会列出每一处，并标出命令行实际使用的「默认」那处；现在卸载时可以选择其中任意一处，留下想用的那份，冲突直接在 CC Switch 里解决。升级前会先核对 Node 版本，不再给出装不上、或者装完跑不起来的升级。

**卸载时可以选择卸载哪一处安装。** 以前确认框只提供当前使用的那一处，而装了多处的用户往往想卸载的是另一处；有多处安装又认不出哪处是默认时，卸载会直接失败。现在确认框会列出检测到的每一处安装，带来源、路径、版本和「默认」标记：只有一处能卸载时自动选中，有两处以上时不预选，不能自动卸载的显示原因并禁用。执行前按你选的路径重新核对一遍，和预览不一致就不执行。

- 支持 Grok Build 0.2.112 起的安装方式（`~/.grok/bin/grok-<version>`），以前会提示「无法自动卸载」。卸载会删除这套安装的全部程序文件，只删文件不删目录，`config.toml` 和会话保留。
- 卸载官方脚本装的工具时，指向同一程序的启动链接（例如 `~/.local/bin/grok`）会一起删除，不再留下失效的命令。
- 已有官方安装、又在 `~/.grok/config.toml` 里设置用 npm 更新时，npm 那一份会被 `grok update` 装回来，确认框会提示这一点。
- Windows 上卸载 Hermes 时，确认框会提示正在运行的 Python 可能被锁定而留下文件；卸载命令成功但随后的状态检查失败时，改为提示「卸载命令已完成，请检查结果」，不再误报卸载失败。

**升级前检查 Node 版本。** OpenClaw 2026.9.3 起要求 Node 24.16 以上，旧版 Node 上升级必然失败，「应用」页却一直显示升级按钮；没有自带检查的 npm 包更糟，npm 只警告一声就装上，装完运行不了。现在发现新版本时会先读取它要求的 Node 版本，和这处安装实际使用的 Node 比较。不满足时这一行写明需要先升级 Node，不显示升级按钮，「全部升级」也会跳过它；执行升级前还会再查一次。认不出的版本写法、查询失败都不会挡住升级；原生程序、Homebrew、Bun 安装和 WSL 里的安装不做这项检查。

**「应用」页更整齐。** 卸载从每行的红色按钮移进行尾的「…」菜单。表头和各行共用同一套列宽，版本列对齐了；读取版本、发现更新、检查更新期间，表头和各列不再左右跳动（[#8293](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8293)）。隐藏应用的说明改写得更明确：只是不显示，供应商、MCP 等配置都还在，它自己的配置文件也不会被改动。

**本地推理服务：Ollama、LM Studio、llama.cpp、vLLM。** 添加供应商时多了一个「本地」分组，放在「云服务商」之后，里面是连接本机推理服务的预设，默认地址就是各服务的默认端口（Ollama 11434、LM Studio 1234、llama.cpp 9931、vLLM 8000），llama.cpp 旧版、Homebrew 和 Docker 常用的 8080 端口作为备选地址。这些服务默认不校验 Key，预设里填的是各家文档用的占位值。使用前要先启动服务、下载模型，预设里的默认模型可以换成你本地已有的，也可以点「获取模型列表」从服务读取；上下文窗口以启动服务时设定的长度为准。

- Claude Code、Codex 直接连本地服务的 Anthropic Messages 和 Responses 接口，Claude Desktop 经路由连接；OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Pi 按各自已有的内置供应商情况提供（应用自带了的就不重复添加）。
- 发往本机地址（localhost、127.0.0.1 等）的请求不再走 CC Switch 设置的代理或系统代理。以前设置了代理时，路由转发、测速、获取模型这些请求会被送进代理，连不上本地服务。

**预设：** 新增 Ollama Cloud、Baseten、Meta Model API、DeepInfra、Vercel AI Gateway、Nebius Token Factory、Groq、SambaNova、DigitalOcean、Hugging Face、Microsoft Foundry、Fireworks AI、Mistral AI、Cloudflare AI Gateway；OpenCode 新增硅基流动国内站和国际站（[#4500](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/4500)）；StreamLake 新增 Codex 预设，所有 StreamLake 预设改用公开的 KAT-Coder 接入点，不用再自己创建接入点 ID。

## 改进

**会话日志扫描：后台更省资源，用量页更及时。** 以前不管用不用得上，后台都每 60 秒把会话日志扫一遍，长时间开着 CC Switch 时，这部分读盘和 CPU 一直在消耗；而用量页的「自动刷新间隔」只是重新查一遍数据库，会话用量仍然要等这 60 秒，选 5 秒也没用（[#8301](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8301)）。现在这个设置改名为「会话日志扫描间隔」：打开用量页时立即扫描一次，窗口重新显示时再扫一次，之后按所选间隔（5、10、30、60 秒，默认 60 秒）扫描；后台扫描改为每 10 分钟一次，只作兜底，平时的后台消耗明显减少。「关闭」选项去掉了，关闭「自动扫描会话日志」时不显示这个设置。经路由的用量本来就是实时记录的，不受影响。

**供应商搜索框不再遮挡或推开卡片。** 搜索框以前浮在列表上方，会挡住第一张卡片的编辑和更多操作按钮（[#8100](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8100)）。现在它放在卡片上方那一行的最右端：Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok Build 放在模式那一行，其他应用放在「已添加」标题那一行。打开搜索时卡片既不被挡住，也不会被往下推。

**界面语言。** 新增土耳其语，由社区翻译，还没翻译的文字显示英文（[#8208](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8208)）。首次启动时，如果系统语言是界面不支持的语言（德语、法语、韩语等），界面和托盘改用英文，不再默认简体中文；已经选过的语言不受影响。

## 修复

- **云同步恢复 Skills 失败一次之后，再也恢复不了**（[#8153](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8153)）。Windows 上下载云同步时如果遇到文件被占用（os error 5），会留下 `skills.bak`，之后每次恢复都在处理它时失败。现在恢复时把云端的 Skills 完整复制到单独的目录再整体替换，不再复用 `skills.bak`；替换和回滚都失败时保留原来的完整副本，并在报错里给出它的位置。
- **Claude Code 经路由连接 OpenAI Responses 上游时，回复已经结束又收到一条错误**（[#8138](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8138)）。上游在发完结束事件后才断开连接时，CC Switch 会在正常结束之后再补发一个流错误，客户端可能把完整的回复当成失败。现在结束之后的连接错误不再转发。
- **在 MCP、提示词、定价编辑页再次点击侧栏的当前页面，会丢掉「有未保存的修改」的保护**（[#7900](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7900)）。以前会弹出放弃更改的确认，确认后编辑页还开着，但之后离开页面就不再提醒，改动直接丢失。现在点击当前页面什么也不做。
- **上游返回空错误内容时，错误信息结尾是一个孤零零的冒号**（[#6910](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6910)），看起来像 CC Switch 吞掉了上游的说明。现在会写明「上游未返回错误内容」。
- **Pi 会话历史的速度一直显示「—」**（[#8278](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8278)）。Pi 会话导入时耗时固定记成 0，现在按每条回复的请求开始时间和写入时间估算耗时，符合条件的记录能显示估算速度。
- **Pi 配置目录指向 WSL 时，每次写入都先尝试 WSL 不支持的系统调用**（[#8245](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8245)）。启用 Skills、保存 AGENTS.md 时，现在直接使用在 WSL 路径上可用的写法；自动模式下同步 Skills 改为复制，手动选了软链接的仍会明确报错。
- **Windows 上自动更新重启后，读取 OpenCode、Codex 自带的模型列表时仍可能找不到工具**（[#8262](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8262)）。v4.0.11 修好了安装和升级，这次把补全后的 PATH 也用到这两处；PATH 里 `%PNPM_HOME%` 这样的变量引用也会按用户和系统环境变量展开。

## 升级说明

**数据库结构没有变化**，仍然是 20。

- 没打开用量页时，后台每 10 分钟扫描一次会话日志（以前是 60 秒），所以不经路由的用量最多晚 10 分钟进入统计；打开用量页会立即扫描。以前选了「关闭」的，改为 60 秒。
- Pi 的速度估算只对升级后新导入的记录生效，已经导入的记录仍显示「—」。
- 新预设和 StreamLake 的改动只影响新添加的供应商，已添加的 StreamLake 供应商仍使用原来的接入点 ID。
- Claude Desktop 选择本地预设时，表单会清空 Key，需要手动填上占位值：Ollama 填 `ollama`，LM Studio 填 `lmstudio`，llama.cpp 填 `no-key`，vLLM 填 `dummy`；启动服务时设了 Key 的，填你设的值。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @funkpopo（用量页会话扫描间隔、「应用」页列对齐、卸载反馈与 Windows PATH 跟进、Pi 会话速度估算）、@xue-ding-e（Skills 恢复失败、Responses 回复结束后的流错误、搜索框遮挡卡片）、@alkank（土耳其语界面与托盘）、@AristurtleHu（Pi 配置目录在 WSL 时的写入）、@Owlbay（未保存更改保护）、@loulanyue（上游空错误内容）、@xwil1（OpenCode 硅基流动预设）、@Lingbou（Windows CI 测试超时）的贡献。

感谢 @HessianZ、@bubblevv、@JimMoen、@chufeng、@Wikian233 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: CC Switch v4.0.11
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.11

本版本为应用增加了卸载功能，现在你可以在「应用」页安装、更新、卸载编程应用了。卸载前确认框会列出要卸载的安装路径和将执行的命令，只卸载能确认来源的安装，配置和会话数据都保留；菜单里另有按安装方式列出的手动卸载命令。添加套餐类供应商（Kimi、智谱、MiniMax 等）时，所有应用都会默认开启套餐额度查询，不再只限 Claude Code，一键导入链接也一样。Codex 用量统计修了两个问题：分叉出来的会话不再每分钟整份重读一遍，Codex 桌面版长会话翻页后分出的子代理用量也能统计了。另外修复了 Windows 上 CC Switch 自动更新重启后安装、升级工具找不到 npm，全屏页面打开时闪烁，以及 Skills 和 MCP 批量开关全部失败时仍提示成功等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.11-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.11-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**「应用」页可以卸载已安装的工具。** 每个已安装的工具旁边多了「卸载」按钮。点击后先检查当前使用的是哪一处安装，确认框里列出将卸载的安装路径和将执行的命令，确认后才执行；执行前会重新检查一遍，安装情况有变化就不执行。只卸载能确认来源的安装：

- 用 npm 全局安装的（核对包名和安装前缀）；
- 用 Homebrew 安装的 Claude Code、Codex（cask）和 Gemini CLI、OpenCode（formula），其他 Homebrew 包一律不碰；
- 用官方安装脚本安装的 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、OpenCode，只删除当前使用的那个可执行文件和它的启动入口，不删除目录，Claude Code 的其他旧版本仍会保留；
- Hermes 调用它自己的 `hermes uninstall --yes`；OpenClaw 先执行官方命令卸载 Gateway 服务，成功后再卸载 CLI。
- Windows 上装在 WSL 里的工具会在对应发行版内卸载，和版本检测用同一个 shell，所以用 nvm 之类装的工具也能找到。

配置和会话数据都保留；有多处安装时只卸载当前使用的那一处，其他的保留。认不出来源的安装不会自动卸载，会提示改用手动命令。「应用」页菜单里新增「手动卸载命令」，按安装方式（npm、pnpm、Bun、Homebrew 等）和运行环境列出各工具的卸载命令，可以复制到终端执行。

**预设：** 新增 StreamLake 国内站、AIComing、SoruxGPT Coding Plan、GrooRoute Pro；修正 StreamLake 国际站 OpenCode、OpenClaw、Pi 预设的地址；AIGoCode 改用新域名。

## 改进

**套餐额度查询在所有应用里默认开启。** 添加地址属于套餐的供应商（Kimi、智谱、MiniMax、火山引擎、OpenCode Go、Command Code）时，以前只有 Claude Code 默认开启套餐额度查询，Codex、OpenCode、Pi、Hermes 等应用要再手动打开一次。现在所有应用都默认开启。一键导入链接也一样：链接没带用量查询脚本、地址属于套餐时，导入后默认开启，确认框里会写明「套餐额度：Kimi For Coding」这样的套餐名；链接写了 `usageEnabled=false` 时仍然关闭。ZenMux 仍只在 Claude Code 里默认开启。已经添加的供应商不受影响。

**全屏页面不再淡入淡出。** v4.0.10 去掉了添加、编辑供应商页面的淡入淡出，但「新增定价」「配置用量查询」「请求地址管理」、统一供应商、工作区文件等页面在 Windows 上打开时仍会闪一下。现在所有全屏页面都不再淡入淡出，macOS 和 Linux 上也一样；授权中心从右侧滑入的动画保留。工作区文件和每日记忆会在内容读完后再打开编辑页，不再先闪出加载页。

## 修复

- **Windows 上 CC Switch 自动更新重启后，安装、升级工具时找不到 npm**（[#8171](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8171)）。安装包更新后自动重启的 CC Switch 拿不到完整的用户 PATH。版本检测以前已经从注册表补回了 PATH，所以显示工具已安装；但执行安装、升级命令时用的仍是残缺的 PATH，于是找不到 npm。现在执行命令时也用补全后的 PATH，卸载同样受益。
- **Codex 分叉出来的会话每分钟被整份重读一遍**（[#8217](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8217)、[#8209](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8209)）。子代理会话、「分支到新聊天」或回退产生的分叉会话，如果父会话还没写到分叉时刻，用量导入会先跳过、稍后再试。从 v3.18 起，每 60 秒一次的同步都会把这些会话整份重新读一遍，再在日志里写一条警告；分叉会话多的用户累计读盘可达数 TB，日志很快涨到轮转上限。现在会记下子会话和父会话文件的状态，文件没变就直接跳过，有变化才重试。计费规则不变：父会话一直没写到分叉时刻（例如闲置很久之后才分叉）的会话，用量仍不计入，这个口径还在讨论中（[#5687](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/5687)）。
- **Codex 桌面版长会话翻页后，分出的子代理用量全部丢失**（[#7084](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7084)、[#8210](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8210)）。Codex 桌面版把长会话分页保存，第一页写满后续写到新文件，CC Switch 以前只找得到第一页，翻页之后分出的子代理就一直被判为「父会话还没写到分叉时刻」，用量从 v3.20.1 起一直没统计。现在会把同一会话的各页按顺序拼起来再判断。这些子代理会话以前没被导入过，升级后下一轮同步会自动补上，只要会话文件还在。分叉线程自己翻页之后的续写页仍然统计不到，会在后续版本处理（[#8161](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8161)）。
- **Skills 和 MCP 批量启用、停用全部失败时仍提示成功。** 现在全部失败时显示红色错误提示，部分失败时显示警告；撤销也按实际结果提示，不再总是显示「已撤销」。
- **工作区编辑器可能把上一个文件的内容存进当前文件。** 打开一个文件再关掉、接着打开另一个文件时，如果后者读取失败，编辑页会在新文件名下继续显示前一个文件的内容，这时点保存就会覆盖新文件。现在读取失败会回到文件列表。

## 升级说明

**数据库结构没有变化**，仍然是 20。

- Codex 子代理用量的补导在升级后的下一轮同步中自动进行，只涉及以前因为父会话分页而一直跳过的子会话，不会重复计入已经导入过的用量。

name: v2.11.29 — CLI and tooling fixes from @rudycelekli, each checked against the vendor's current docs.
body:
CLI and tooling fixes from @rudycelekli, each checked against the vendor's current docs.

- **Request deadlines** (#751): HTTP calls in 65 CLIs now time out instead of hanging. The default is 120 seconds, raised from #751's 30 so long scrapes and exports aren't cut off; override it with `--timeout-ms`.
- **Mixpanel regions** (#744): US, EU, and India ingestion, query, and export hosts.
- **Payload validation before sending:** the CLIs now reject inputs the vendor's API would refuse anyway. Valid empty and nested values still pass.
  - Amplitude event properties (#801)
  - SendGrid dynamic template data (#803)
  - Kit custom fields (#806)
  - Segment properties and traits (#808)
  - Customer.io data objects (#811)
  - Mixpanel properties (#813)
  - Resend batch size (#816) and template variables (#828)
  - OneSignal conflicting audiences (#818)
  - Intercom event metadata (#822)
  - Dub bulk link limits (#824)
  - Pendo aggregation envelopes (#830)
- **Correctness:** Close opportunity amounts keep exact integers instead of truncating (#831).

name: v2.11.28 — Skill fixes from @rudycelekli. A reviewer recomputed every calculation, and the guidance…
body:
Skill fixes from @rudycelekli. A reviewer recomputed every calculation, and the guidance stays firm where a change would otherwise have hedged it.

- **Math:**
  - **offers** (1.0.1 → 1.0.2): multiply sequential lifts rather than adding them (#809).
  - **churn-prevention** (2.0.2 → 2.0.3): dunning ROI stated net of tooling, at 5–14x (#810). Health scores put every signal on one 0–100 scale and handle missing signals explicitly (#829).
  - **co-marketing** (2.0.2 → 2.0.3): marketplace fees are recurring costs, not CAC, and Arrows is listed on the HubSpot Marketplace (#812).
  - **referrals** (2.2.0 → 2.2.1): program return measured after serving costs (#820).
  - **ab-testing** (2.0.1 → 2.0.2): test duration accounts for the number of arms and exposure (#819).
- **Methods:**
  - **attribution** (1.1.4 → 1.1.5): intent-to-treat analysis vs. on-off tests, and an interval that includes zero is not a win (#815).
  - **revops** (2.2.0 → 2.2.1): calibrate scoring on snapshots taken at decision time and on holdouts (#817).
  - **pricing** (2.1.3 → 2.1.4): the direction of the Van Westendorp "too cheap" curves (#821).
  - **onboarding** (2.0.1 → 2.0.2): early activation measured separately from mature retention (#826). Card-required trials judged on visitor→paid, with ChartMogul's ~30% trial→paid (over 5x no-card) as context (#827).
- **Platform facts:**
  - **seo-audit** (2.2.0 → 2.2.1): hreflang findings scoped to the affected pairs, and x-default treated as optional (#823).
  - **ads** (2.4.6 → 2.4.7): screen headlines in Meta, then prove the winner with a landing-page test, without the made-up lift thresholds (#825).

name: v4.1.24
body:
### Changed

- With no model chosen, the Cline and OpenRouter providers now use Claude Sonnet 5.5. For Cline, that's the first model in Cline's recommended list.
- Selecting ai& shows its own API key and model picker, instead of the generic OpenAI-compatible form with base URL and custom headers.
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds Claude Haiku 5.5 and the AI/ML API, LowRouter, and Prime Inference providers. The Cline free list adds Step 5 Preview. The v0 provider now offers only its default model, `v0-1.5-md`, and OpenCode Go uses its new `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` endpoint. Default models change for 302.AI, Cortecs, CrossModel, DevPass, DigitalOcean, Eden AI, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Meta, Moark, NanoGPT, NEAR AI Cloud, Neuralwatt, Novita AI, Ofox, OpenCode Go, Requesty, Vivgrid, and a few others (most now Claude Haiku 5.5 or Muse Wonder 1.0). If you use one of those providers without pinning a model, expect a different default.

### Fixed

- Turning reasoning off no longer fails with a 400 error on GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Fable 5 or Claude Opus 5.5, and now works on every provider. Level-only Gemini models no longer reject the request with a thinking-budget error.
- An MCP server or hook that exits before reading all of its input no longer crashes the extension host about 3 seconds later.
- A 404 from a stale or retired model id is no longer shown as a sign-in problem. Cline shows the real error instead of the logged-out card.
- Errors in the Cline output log keep their details. Production builds used to drop them, so a line like "Cline OAuth login failed:" showed no reason.
- Deleting a slash command from the input keeps the spacing of the text around it.
- Screenshots and other images no longer inflate the token estimate, which made auto-compaction run long before the conversation was near its limit.
- Auto-compaction uses the selected model's context window when the catalog entry has none.
- Rule files that are symlinks now load, and skills in `.claude/skills` are now discovered.
- The editor tool no longer receives null in place of the text to replace from some models.
- Settings migrated from older versions no longer add an empty SAP AI Core provider.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.23...v4.1.24

body:

The v0 provider now offers only its default model, `v0-1.5-md`, and OpenCode Go uses its new `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` endpoint. The Cline free list adds Step 5 Preview.
