name: rea-agents: v6.5.0
body:
## [6.5.0](https://github.com/morluto/rea/compare/rea-agents-6.4.0...rea-agents-6.5.0) (2026-10-13)

Provider prerequisites and recorded verification scope are listed in [the testing guide](docs/testing.md).

### Highlights

- Analyze selected JavaScript files and recover cross-bundle relationships without expanding the selected source scope.
- Read compact summaries and page retained Evidence across binary, managed, Android, Dart, WASM and network workflows.
- Inspect SQLite snapshots, packet and signal recordings, WebAssembly, Rust dependency metadata and Electron fuses offline.
- Keep completed Evidence and partial observations available when analysis or cleanup fails.

### Changes

- **JavaScript source selection:** analyze exact application paths without expanding imports into the selected scope. Unselected files retain identity and explicit unknown coverage; summary delivery remains separate from source selection. ([#1944](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1944), [issue morluto/rea#1848](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1848)). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
- **Code-split recovery:** recover related bundles from multiple selected inputs, retaining per-file provenance and downstream cross-chunk imports. Recorded CLI/MCP coverage is Linux x64 with Wakaru 1.14.0 and source-owned esbuild/webpack fixtures; other hosts, releases and arbitrary application equivalence remain unverified. ([#1686](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1686), [issue morluto/rea#1605](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1605)). Thanks @JingHao-Leon, @pionxzh.
- **Package imports:** resolve exact package import aliases using the selected loader and package ancestry, rather than guessing sibling files. ([#1862](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1862), [issue morluto/rea#1838](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1838)). Thanks @AWUQAQ, @mvanhorn.
- **Retained analysis views:** opt into compact inventory/WASM, managed metadata, Android manifest, Dart AOT, Mach-O and EVM summaries, then page retained Evidence without rerunning analysis. Summary delivery preserves the complete recorded result and its original coverage. ([#2122](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2122), [#2193](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2193), [#2413](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2413), [#2438](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2438), [#2455](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2455), [#2634](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2634), [#2308](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2308), [9a18251](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/9a18251426f891e6a24856b715ef8002ab8b9610)). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
- **Managed assemblies:** Select declaring types when inspecting members, decode inspected `ldstr` literals with independent coverage, and page retained member summaries. Call and field targets expose `target_declaring_type` and `field_declaring_type`, including supported generic method targets; unresolved metadata remains unknown. ([#1706](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1706), [#2125](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2125), [issue morluto/rea#2121](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2121), [#2162](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2162), [issue morluto/rea#2158](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2158), [#3061](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/3061), [issue morluto/rea#3010](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/3010), [#2163](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2163), [issue morluto/rea#2160](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2160)). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @Nelglor, @skoodster.
- **Packet captures:** inspect saved packets with bounded TShark output, compact capture summaries and retained pages; discover installed protocol/field definitions. Recorded real-engine coverage uses Linux and Wireshark 4.6.6; native Windows/macOS and Bun behavior remain unverified. ([#2318](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2318), [#2340](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2340), [#2496](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2496)). Thanks @3QL, @N0zoM1z0, @Olorinm.
- **Recorded signals:** decode existing recordings and discover installed decoders/options through caller-supplied sigrok-cli 0.7.2. This is Linux-only and requires util-linux `prlimit`; it acquires no hardware samples. ([#2339](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2339), [#2487](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2487)). Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @Olorinm.
- **Web captures:** derive an inferred method/origin/path-template API surface from retained HAR data including observed query-parameter names while retaining unknowns; query values, headers and bodies remain excluded. ([#1891](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1891), [#2982](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2982), [issue morluto/rea#2913](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2913)). Thanks @mvanhorn, @wunianze666-netizen, @zhangguiping-xydt.
- **QUIC captures:** inspect retained aioquic 1.5.0 JSON qlog 0.3 objects and page traces/streams/observations. Other qlog layouts remain unsupported; overlap and loss declarations do not prove retransmission or network loss. ([#2277](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2277)). Thanks @LuisTaffelli, @N0zoM1z0.
- **Fiddler captures:** inspect native SAZ archives with retained HTTP provenance and bounded decoding. Recorded producer coverage is the pinned public encoding corpus; current Fiddler Everywhere variants and Bun-native execution remain unverified. ([#2409](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2409)). Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @zahhak.
- **SQLite snapshots:** inspect an explicitly selected offline database with table/column selection and bounded Evidence. This operation requires Node 24.x >=24.15 or 26+ with `DatabaseSync.limits`; supported Node 22 and earlier 24 runtimes cannot use it. A live database/WAL copy does not establish an atomic snapshot. ([#2271](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2271)). Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @Y0UW1SH.
- **WASM artifacts:** Inspect local modules with bring-your-own WABT 1.0.42 without executing them. Compare imports/exports from two complete core-module inspection Evidence records without requiring an active WABT installation; unsupported signatures and duplicate identities remain unknown, and comparisons do not establish runtime compatibility. Recorded real-tool inspection coverage is macOS arm64. ([#1764](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1764), [issue morluto/rea#1712](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1712), [#1778](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1778), [issue morluto/rea#1766](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1766), [#1785](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1785), [issue morluto/rea#1769](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1769), [#1906](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1906), [issue morluto/rea#1794](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1794), [#2201](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2201), [issue morluto/rea#2139](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2139), [#2291](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2291), [issue morluto/rea#2285](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2285), [#2324](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2324), [12fa8fd](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/12fa8fd9f986dbd4ff58165c3ec71a46dc8a8a3b)). Thanks @akushonkamen, @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @nikolay-dementiev, @zecaro.
- **Input and capability diagnostics:** identify invalid paths, format refusals, missing host tools and non-retryable errors without losing caller selections or retryable capability facts. Foreign execution/device mutation annotations remain destructive, analysis-target text is untrusted, and output ordering follows code points rather than host locale. ([#1770](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1770), [#1867](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1867), [#1869](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1869), [issue morluto/rea#1855](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1855), [#1872](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1872), [#1879](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1879), [issue morluto/rea#1853](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1853), [#1899](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1899), [#1902](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1902), [#1904](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1904), [#1908](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1908), [#1925](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1925), [#1987](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1987), [issue morluto/rea#1979](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1979), [#2004](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2004), [issue morluto/rea#2002](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2002), [#2026](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2026), [#2091](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2091), [#2133](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2133), [issue morluto/rea#2129](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2129), [#2145](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2145), [issue morluto/rea#2143](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2143), [#2472](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2472), [#2478](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2478), [issue morluto/rea#2454](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2454), [#2494](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2494), [#2507](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2507), [#2509](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2509), [#2708](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2708), [3d83135](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/3d8313598785359c424d7305f503cb69fc8639a6), [c9fed50](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/c9fed50691ae014890e91a72534773d2fb58ce44), [8b18171](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/8b181716aca2cb467be499cba226abfb5ae19141), [7a2cd1e](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/7a2cd1ea0a63e8c44166860b7ee9c7a1aa43492b)). Thanks @astralyx0129, @CassieFox23, @DeryFerd, @dollarsmoney, @fisforfaheem, @flitzrrr, @Ha1baraA11, @jimpablo, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @larinyo, @N0zoM1z0, @rudycelekli, @SII-YDD, @viniciusdsandrade, @XiaoBinGan.
- **Android analysis:** retain decoded values, duplicate-class inventories and executable static initializers, reject malformed JADX UTF-8, and keep inline search provenance. Apktool accepts `--no-strings` and explains host requirements. Windows batch-launcher selection also resolves PATH/PATHEXT before choosing its launch mode. Recorded Apktool coverage is Linux/OpenJDK, and changed JADX/batch failure paths do not establish native Windows behavior. ([#1777](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1777), [issue morluto/rea#1774](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1774), [#1876](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1876), [issue morluto/rea#1846](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1846), [#1890](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1890), [issue morluto/rea#1850](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1850), [#1946](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1946), [issue morluto/rea#1945](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1945), [#2707](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2707), [issue morluto/rea#2672](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2672), [0677468](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/0677468877465c8dfbe25c72f142a7b5bc8a3212), [fe8d0bd](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/fe8d0bdd36fe12bc0836468d1a702a34fbdc219b), [#2802](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2802)). Thanks @akushonkamen, @coygeek, @HeadmasterEggy, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @psipher.
- **ADB acquisition:** preserve device paths and directory identity, prevent host destination collisions/overwrites, count UTF-8 logcat bytes and restricted permissions, and evaluate the complete Activity Manager start report. Launch attempts, status, activity and raw failure output remain observations; real-device timeout/mixed-report and Android 8 directory-read paths remain unverified beyond the documented fixtures. ([#1962](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1962), [#2212](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2212), [issue morluto/rea#2175](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2175), [#2221](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2221), [issue morluto/rea#2220](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2220), [#2359](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2359), [c42232f](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/c42232f566d55fe7191763649755148c768eef9f), [55b6148](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/55b61485e9f7568b69597eef8696ff6abfe53cfd), [3bdc873](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/3bdc8730bd98e073522bcb8ba86527be402c0cbe), [c89972c](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/c89972c8777d0114566fe76a060849a18bdd2659), [e1cd292](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/e1cd292aa6e8f5f13441d408c66126782c8dbb0d)). Thanks @coygeek, @dakjdakd, @DeryFerd, @huiq777, @sx4im.
- **WASM names and diagnostics:** preserve debug/custom-section names including NUL and leading BOM, accept unpadded WABT section rows, and avoid irrelevant tool-remediation advice on unrelated runtime-root failures. ([#1963](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1963), [issue morluto/rea#1956](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/1956), [#1967](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1967), [#1981](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1981), [#2084](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2084), [#2102](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2102)). Thanks @1052326311, @bugstan, @N0zoM1z0, @sathariels, @STiFLeR7, @viniciusdsandrade.

- **Source-map and path handling:** retain source-map entries when embedded-content counts differ or an optional `sourceMappingURL` is used, and keep `file:` URLs out of operator-relative path resolution. ([#2873](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2873), [#2886](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2886), [#2882](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2882), [issue morluto/rea#2821](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2821), [issue morluto/rea#2883](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2883), [issue morluto/rea#2577](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2577)). Thanks @JFSAS, @rileygramlich, @shoyann, @shubhamahuja9999, @coygeek.
- **Native metadata:** accept declared facts in native dispatch inventories and share native verification input diagnostics. ([#2906](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2906), [#2901](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2901), [issue morluto/rea#2564](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2564), [issue morluto/rea#2621](https://github.com/morluto/rea/issues/2621)). Thanks @ShitK, @coygeek.

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

- **Runtime attachment state:** `attached` may be `null` in JavaScript, browser and Electron discovery/inspection results. Treat null as unknown; do not coerce it to false. ([e55ef72](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/e55ef7213515ba204c3d88a4487b4ee6a2773b06)).
- **Source maps:** original-source and mapping rows preserve a null source name when unavailable. Handle null explicitly instead of expecting an invented unknown-source string; new index fields remain optional when reading older Evidence. ([ee50ed1](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/ee50ed121e38cc6e1a2ff0dc8b789f15f71c5402)).
- **Streamed filtered JSON:** `--filter-output` now emits JSON `null` instead of `{}` when the selected value is null; consumers must distinguish a present null from a missing selection. Use `--full-output` when an object envelope is required. ([#2333](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/2333)). Thanks @Jackmeson1.
- **Call graphs:** `get_call_graph.normalized_result` is now `{ graph, limitations }`; read traversal-depth groups under `graph` and retain relationship-specific caveats. Contract/fixture validation does not establish new Ghidra or IDA engine coverage. ([5dfb9d0](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/5dfb9d050c2cc44a61b183dae765bef4d22a53b7)).
- **MCP discovery:** `binary_session` no longer repeats `server_identity.catalog.tools`. Use the connected server tool list, grouped `tool_availability` and provider capabilities; see [MCP contracts](docs/mcp-contracts.md). Origin: [6395e8d](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/6395e8d3007d5ee453477460e7ee1c51cff76be0). ([#1988](https://github.com/morluto/rea/pull/1988)). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.

- **Provider admission:** MIPS targets with unresolved GNU ABI attributes are refused. Supply supported ABI declarations. Saved Hopper databases on macOS are unavailable because the launcher cannot run the analysis bridge when opening a database; select an executable target instead. Database support requires a script-capable database launch route. ([d4bd65c](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/d4bd65c53c0254d0195cc7ab8da163dcadfd3b9b)).
- **Segment extents:** `binary_overview` segment length may be null when Hopper coordinates cannot establish a finite extent in one address space. Preserve unknown rather than converting it to zero or a saturated value. ([36db19c](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/36db19c59)).
- **Invocation identity:** `server.command_path` may be null, and registration/setup statuses or doctor classifications may be unknown. Preserve these states and establish the actual invocation before treating a registration as aligned. ([187f113](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/187f113f7)). Thanks @hemv-857, @qorvr.
- **ADB installation:** the optional `replace` input is unchanged. Results now require `replace_requested` to record the requested `adb install -r` mode; `replaced` is nullable because prior device package state was not observed. Update result readers to accept null instead of treating reinstall intent as proof of replacement. ([864314a](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/864314ac857924a7e6e65bfb37e8dc720fcc21e7)).
- **Managed/native verification:** unresolved P/Invoke results may retain `matched_native` and candidate facts when module identity is unknown. Interpret `status`, `basis` and `limitations`; `module-identity-unknown` does not verify correspondence, and unresolved no longer implies empty observations. ([3f6b575](https://github.com/morluto/rea/commit/3f6b5755b3e699bd9373641acffe0f2c5d2ab094)).

Full contribution record: [893 commits and 529 merged PRs](https://github.com/morluto/rea/blob/rea-agents-6.5.0/docs/releases/6.5.0.contributions.json).

name: Niubash v1.4.0
body:
Niubash v1.4.0 packages for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Engine: rubash git c85c3ed0bfca — every platform build in this release compiled that same revision.
Verify locally with `niu --version`, which prints the same revision.

Windows (x64, ARM64): Inno Setup installers (`*-setup.exe`) add user PATH and Windows Terminal profile integration; portable zips bundle `niu` with WinuxCmd and bash/sh shims.

Windows packages come with the must-install bundle pre-installed (niubash#189, niubash#209): niugit (native Windows git — the full plugin distro's five entries install through git, so a fresh machine without git.exe no longer fails `niu setup`), gawk 5.4.1 with plain `awk` working too, plus ripgrep (`rg`) and fd — all landing in the bundled WinuxCmd root as wpm JSON-package payloads, assembled at CI time with no runtime downloads, no archive formats beyond the release zip itself, and no symlinks. Pre-install is best-effort, not a promise: on legs where the package index has no matching artifact (currently niugit and gawk on the ARM64 builds; ripgrep and fd have ARM64 artifacts) the package ships WITHOUT that entry — run `winuxcmd wpm install <name>` once after installing to add it. The pre-install list and its recorded exclusions live in `scripts/release/preinstall.json`.

`niubash-skill-v<version>.zip` is the AI agent skill bundle (SKILL.md + references, WinuxCmd-skill layout): unpack it into an agent skills directory, or let the shell do it — `niu skill install` embeds the same content.

Linux (x86_64, aarch64; glibc): portable tarballs with the `niu` binary, README, and LICENSE — Unix builds bundle nothing, native system tools are used. Untar anywhere and run `./niu`.

macOS (aarch64, x86_64): portable tarballs with the `niu` binary, README, and LICENSE. Untar anywhere and run `./niu`.

Every artifact was smoke-verified on the build OS of the job that produced it, before upload: `niu -c 'echo ok'`, `printf 'a\nb\n' | niu -c 'sort | head -1'`, an offline `NIU_PLUGIN_SPEC=<empty> niu plugin sync --bootstrap` (exit 0, no output, no network), and a `niu --version` check against this tag and the engine revision.

Integrity (niubash#311): `SHA256SUMS` lists the SHA-256 of every shipped artifact, and each Windows installer has a `.sha256` sidecar beside it. `niu --self-update` verifies the installer against the sidecar before running it and aborts rather than execute anything it cannot verify. The same digests feed the winget manifest `InstallerSha256`.

name: v3.1.0
body:
## Archify 3.1.0

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d6144aba-cb48-4692-a24d-b43bf7be62c2

*30 seconds of Archify 3.1: five new diagram types, Live motion, light and dark.*

Ten diagram types, with Live motion enabled by default: **ERD, Class/interface, Tree, Timeline and Waterfall** join Architecture, Workflow, Sequence, Dataflow and Lifecycle.

- Type-specific motion stays separate from authored topology; switch to Still when needed.
- Clearer cards, routing/label coordination, Sequence notes, Lifecycle layouts, and long-page reader navigation.
- Structured authoring diagnostics, bounded recovery, source verification and distinct input/artifact/browser delivery gates.
- Export, clipboard and Windows path portability fixes; a localized optional repository link inside the reader-opened Guide.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/blob/v3.1.0/CHANGELOG.md#310--2026-10-14) · [Release scope and trial-use evidence](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/blob/v3.1.0/docs/releases/3.1.0.md)

Download `archify.zip` below, or use the canonical Skill source. Existing installations update only when their owner chooses to upgrade.

Known limitations include initial-viewport control overlap in some long Sequence diagrams, shared visual corridors in some Dataflow diagrams, and awkward wrapping of long Class generic types. Automated validation does not replace perceptual review. Timeline/Waterfall values require evidence to be described as factual/measured; illustrative examples remain labelled.

The independently published DSH plugin remains 1.0.0 / bundled Archify 3.0.1; its synchronization is a separate follow-up. Expanded public examples, README previews and website entry points are tracked in #916, #917 and #918.

Source: `1c2b42d660e4a7571813fb43839c79e3e9ca7720` (included in stable main). ZIP SHA-256: `ffedc53390c9da6e859f41e432c5d2d0615a23cf00a503181f07efbba88a7ce8`.

## Release Notes

Released on 2026-10-14.

### Enhancements

- Ignore `Requires-Python` upper bounds in `uv pip check` and `uv pip install --strict`, consistent with resolution ([#22500](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22500))
- Support Linux SPARC by falling back when filesystem cloning and detailed cache accounting are unavailable ([#22463](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22463))
- Report missing trusted hashes in resolution errors ([#22241](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22241))

### Python

- Add CPython 3.16.0a1 ([#22527](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22527))

### Preview features

- Allow `uv tool upgrade` to upgrade installed tools when `tool-install-locks` is enabled ([#22498](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22498))
- Add preliminary support for parsing PEP 825 variant labels in wheel filenames with `wheel-variants` ([#22039](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22039))

### Performance

- Reduce uv's binary size ([#22429](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22429), [#22430](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22430), [#22432](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22432))
- Speed up Simple API parsing ([#22429](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22429))
- Reduce package metadata parsing overhead ([#22239](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22239))

### Bug fixes

- Prevent tool and managed Python uninstalls from deleting unrelated files beside their storage directories ([#22495](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22495))
- Restore support for source distributions containing hard links or full-length tar user or group names ([#22516](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22516), [#22522](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22522))
- Preserve device files and FIFOs used as `uv pip compile` or `uv export` output destinations ([#22496](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22496))
- Fix `sys._base_executable` detection for environments created from symlinked interpreters ([#22520](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22520))
- Prevent concurrent readers from observing partially written lockfiles, Python version files, or managed Python sysconfig files ([#22399](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22399), [#22402](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22402), [#22403](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22403))
- Serialize concurrent project commands that reach the same environment through real and symlinked paths ([#22390](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22390))
- Prevent installs, syncs, and environment creation from failing when they race with `uv cache clean` ([#22387](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22387))
- Prevent concurrent tool installations from corrupting an environment when the last tool is uninstalled ([#22391](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22391))
- Persist changed upgrade settings even when `uv tool upgrade` leaves the tool version unchanged ([#22499](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22499))
- Reuse environments with installed Git dependencies pinned to full commit hashes without resolving again ([#22464](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22464))

### Documentation

- Explain how to select an emulated Python interpreter on Windows ARM64 when native wheels are unavailable ([#22424](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22424))
- Fix the `.netrc` format documentation link ([#22514](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22514))

### Other changes

- Publish Python 3.15-based uv Docker images under stable tags ([#22503](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22503))

curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.1/uv-installer.sh | sh

name: v13.39.0
body:
## Codex: memory timeline returns to subagent threads after compaction

When Codex compacts a thread, the memory timeline drops out of its history. The root thread already got it back through `SessionStart` (source `compact`). Codex never sends `SessionStart` to subagent threads, though, so a subagent that compacted kept working without its memory.

- A new **PostCompact** hook marks the compacted thread, keyed by `session_id` plus `agent_id`.
- That thread's next **PostToolUse** records the observation as usual, consumes the marker, and returns the timeline once as `additionalContext`.
- **SessionStart** clears the marker, so the root thread never gets the timeline twice.
- Shared session-marker file handling now backs both the Codex compaction gate and the Kimi context gate.

PR: #4733

name: v13.38.0
body:
No more console window flashing on Windows. Every Claude Code hook now calls claude-mem directly instead of going through bash, and this release also carries 16 community fixes from five contributors.

## Hooks call claude-mem directly (#4345)

Every Claude Code runtime hook now runs a small `claude-mem` launcher in exec form (`"command": "claude-mem", "args": [...]`), with no shell in between. On Windows that ends the console window that used to flash and steal focus on every tool call (#3605, #3559, #3521, #3396, #3248).

- `npx claude-mem install` / `update` compile the launcher on your machine. It goes to `~/.local/bin/claude-mem` on macOS and Linux, or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-mem\bin\claude-mem.exe` on Windows, and that folder is added to your PATH if it isn't there already. `npx claude-mem uninstall` removes the launcher.
- Marketplace-only installs repair themselves. A startup step places or refreshes the launcher and tells you when Claude Code needs a restart.
- The launcher fails open. On any problem it prints one line, `claude-mem: <reason>, continuing without memory`, and your session carries on.
- The environment opt-outs (`CLAUDE_MEM_DISABLE_TOOL_HOOKS`, `CLAUDE_MEM_DISABLE_OBSERVATION`, `CLAUDE_MEM_DISABLE_FILE_CONTEXT`) still take effect before anything heavy starts.

**Before you upgrade:**
- Hooks in exec form need **Claude Code 2.1.139 or newer**. `install` and `doctor` warn on older versions.
- If the launcher's folder wasn't on your PATH yet, the first session after updating will tell you to **restart Claude Code from a new terminal**. After that, everything works as before.

Thanks @bagr001 for testing it on Windows 11.

## Observer and worker

- **Gateways that reject the `thinking` parameter no longer stall the observer** (#4735, @akushonkamen). The observer retries once without the parameter. The token-saving default is unchanged, and `CLAUDE_MEM_OBSERVER_THINKING` is now documented.
- **The worker no longer wedges for hours on big repos** (#4753, @akushonkamen). Git commands during worktree adoption now run without blocking the event loop.
- **The streamed-request idle window is configurable** (#4752, @akushonkamen) with `CLAUDE_MEM_LLM_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`, for self-hosted backends with long queue waits. The default is still 90 seconds.
- **`CLAUDE_MEM_DISABLE_SUMMARY=1`** skips the end-of-session summary for headless or read-only runs (#4736, @akushonkamen).
- **Mode prompts are validated**, and a user mode file can no longer shadow a bundled mode (#4326).
- **Three platform fixes** (#3851):
  - manual sessions keep their platform;
  - an error-shaped response is no longer taken for a host observer;
  - Grok agents added after install are watched.
- **The Codex installer drops a dead local marketplace registration**, and install fails when Codex doesn't list the plugin afterwards (#3494).

## Search, viewer and data, thank you @rudycelekli

- Semantic search no longer breaks on empty filters (#4754) or on malformed stored concept or file data (#4750). It now matches keyword search.
- The Sessions list matches project names regardless of case (#4749).
- Feed rows with the same timestamp come back in a stable newest-first order (#4747).
- Repeated prompts with their own native turn ids are no longer merged into one (#4748).
- Restoring an export keeps each prompt's native turn id (#4751).
- Deleting a project's last memories brings the welcome hint back right away (#4742).
- A corpus built without a limit gets the documented 500 observations, and limits above 100 are no longer capped at 100 (#4746).

## Sync and server

- **Chroma writes for the same memory are serialized and re-read the current row** (#4731, @junnhwan). A startup backfill or a delayed cloud forward can no longer index an old body or old project.
- **On the self-hosted server, a reclaimed generation attempt can't complete or fail its replacement** (#4739, @junnhwan). Postgres regression tests now run in CI.
- **The self-hosted sync server puts brackets around IPv6 hosts** in its advertised URL (#4723, @DeryFerd).

## Viewer

- The NOTES section icon is sized like its siblings (#4744, @phant0um, first contribution). It used to render about 20× too large.

## Claude app (cowork) plugin

- Session-init now runs in the background, and the plugin's hooks stand down when a local claude-mem install is present (#4755).

## Docs and skills

- The make-plan skill has a Primary Goal section and a fixed short chat summary (#3600).
- The wowerpoint skill stops once the deck has started and no longer uploads (#4342).
- Docs no longer mention workers.dev for the sync hub (#4366).

Thanks to everyone who reported and fixed things this round: @rudycelekli, @junnhwan, @akushonkamen, @DeryFerd, @phant0um, @valerianbbragi, @smashingtags, @wuding129, @chris-yyau, @bagr001.

**Full diff:** https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v13.37.0...v13.38.0

[中文](#cn-v0.2.1-alpha.3-community) | [English](#en-v0.2.1-alpha.3-community)

新增功能

- Web 版支持在本机 HTTP 访问时登录 DeepSeek 账号。 @lsdsjy - 支持识别已发送消息中的密钥和令牌，并默认脱敏按需查看。 @ZiyaZhang - 极简模式支持读取图片和自动压缩长对话，Web 与桌面端可通过 /compact 指令手动压缩上下文。 @LogosVeritas ### 问题修复 - 修复切换会话、收起工作过程或发送后续消息时，对话区域出现大块空白、滚动跳动的问题。 @imccyu - 修复重启应用后部分会话无法继续，以及切换到 DeepSeek 后因历史消息兼容问题导致请求失败的情况。 @imccyu, @yudshj - 修复插件更新或重新安装后仍运行旧代码的问题。启用热重载时，可替换的插件会直接生效；无法热重载的情况会提示重启。 @turtle1999 - 修复 macOS 添加工作区时目录选择器无法粘贴目录路径，以及取消选择仍添加工作区的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复原预设被删除或调整后，恢复空白会话、切换工作区可能失败的问题。 @LegGasai - 修复部分较旧 Git 版本下无法创建工作树的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复远程 Web 在网络拥塞时被误判为断线，以及刷新后语言、主题等偏好丢失的问题。 @turtle2099, @oraluben - 应用意外退出后，未完成的任务会明确显示“任务已停止”，避免被误认为正常完成。 @turtle2099 - 凭据文件中出现 DSH 不使用的额外字段时，不再阻止应用启动。 @turtle2099 - 修复卸载会话存储插件时，最后的会话记录可能丢失的问题。 @turtle1999 ### 体验优化 - 改善会话列表加载和 @ 会话搜索体验 @imccyu - 子智能体可通过配置选用独立 Agent Preset 预设，统一设置角色和工具； @grllll, @Dudu-0223 - 优化侧栏展开规则，让运行中和等待回应的会话更容易找到；会话菜单支持复制会话 ID。 @turtle1999, @imccyu - DeepSeek 账号的模型列表随账号可用模型更新，并隐藏当前客户端版本不支持的模型。 @LegGasai - 模型设置更清楚地提示凭据来源和检测状态，支持按需显示输入的 API Key。 @Magolor - Office 文档任务按需加载编辑、渲染和导出指引，减少简单内容修改中不必要的检查与预览。 @yudshj - 改进子智能体的委派与等待指引：达到委派层数上限时提前提示，等待子任务期间不再消耗新的目标执行轮次。 @ZiyaZhang, @turtle1999 - Web 终端更可靠地处理连续输入、粘贴和尺寸调整，并保留进程退出前的最后输出。 @LegGasai - 桌面端可用 Cmd/Ctrl + 加号或减号统一调整正文、代码和终端字号。 @koalazf99 - 优化会话和工作区的悬停操作，统一卡片与菜单样式，并改善页头排列及插件页、自动化任务页的窄窗口布局。 @Yifffan, @Kingwl - PTC Mode 的 Node 执行环境新增可选的 in-memory 模式，多次运行代码可复用变量、函数和已导入模块。 @CreatixChu ### 其他变更 - API Key 读取优先级变更：Web端/桌面端优先采用已保存的凭据；headless 默认改用环境变量和 .env，不读取已保存的密钥。 @Magolor - 更新第三方模型支持；Azure 提供方名称统一为 azure，使用旧名称 azure-openai-responses 的提供方配置需迁移。 @LegGasai - Python SDK 的 Office 引擎和完整创作环境改为按需下载。 @yudshj - 使用 --from-default-profile 重建已有自定义配置时，会替换该配置及其插件和设置。 @turtle2099 - TypeScript 和 Python SDK 支持 resume 功能，恢复已保存的会话，继续使用原有会话 ID 和工作目录。 @koalazf99 ---

New Features

- The Web app supports DeepSeek account sign-in when accessed over local HTTP. by @lsdsjy - Detect keys and tokens in sent messages and mask them by default, with an option to reveal them. by @ZiyaZhang - Minimal mode can read images and automatically compact long conversations. Web and Desktop users can run the /compact command to compact context manually. by @LogosVeritas ### Bug Fixes - Fix large blank areas and scroll jumps when switching sessions, collapsing work details, or sending follow-up messages. by @imccyu - Fix failures when continuing some sessions after an application restart, and history compatibility errors when switching to DeepSeek. by @imccyu, @yudshj - Fix stale plugin code after updates or reinstallation. With hot reload enabled, replaceable plugins take effect immediately; changes that cannot be hot-reloaded request a restart. by @turtle1999 - Fix pasting directory paths into the directory picker when adding a workspace on macOS, and prevent cancelled selections from adding a workspace. by @turtle2099 - Fix failures when restoring a blank session or switching workspaces after its original preset was removed or changed. by @LegGasai - Fix worktree creation failures with some older Git versions. by @turtle2099 - Fix false disconnects during network congestion and lost language, theme, and other preferences after refreshing a remote Web client. by @turtle2099, @oraluben - Tasks interrupted by an application exit now show “Task stopped” instead of appearing to have completed normally. by @turtle2099 - Extra fields that DSH does not use in the credentials file no longer prevent the application from starting. by @turtle2099 - Fix a case where final session records could be lost while unloading the session storage plugin. by @turtle1999 ### Improvements - Improve session list loading and @ session search. by @imccyu - Configure spawned subagents with independent Agent Presets to manage their roles and tools together. by @grllll, @Dudu-0223 - Improve sidebar expansion so running sessions and sessions awaiting a response are easier to find. Session menus support copying the session ID. by @turtle1999, @imccyu - Keep the DeepSeek account model list up to date with the models available to the account, while hiding models unsupported by the current client version. by @LegGasai - Model settings show clearer credential sources and detection status, and let users reveal an entered API key. by @Magolor - Load Office editing, rendering, and export guidance as needed, reducing unnecessary checks and previews for simple content edits. by @yudshj - Improve subagent delegation and waiting guidance: announce delegation depth limits in advance and wait for running subtasks before starting another goal round. by @ZiyaZhang, @turtle1999 - Handle continuous input, pastes, and resizing more reliably in the Web terminal, and preserve the final output when a process exits. by @LegGasai - Use Cmd/Ctrl + plus or minus on Desktop to adjust text, code, and terminal font sizes together. by @koalazf99 - Refine session and workspace hover interactions, unify card and menu styling, and improve header ordering and narrow-window layouts on plugin and automation pages. by @Yifffan, @Kingwl - The Node runtime for PTC Mode adds an optional in-memory mode that reuses variables, functions, and imported modules across code executions. by @CreatixChu ### Chores - Change API key precedence: Web and Desktop prioritize saved credentials. Headless uses environment variables and .env files by default, without reading saved keys. by @Magolor - Update third-party model support and rename the Azure provider to azure. Provider configurations using azure-openai-responses must be migrated. by @LegGasai - The Python SDK’s Office engine and full authoring environment are now downloaded on demand. by @yudshj - Using --from-default-profile to recreate an existing custom profile replaces that profile, including its plugins and settings. by @turtle2099 - The TypeScript and Python SDKs support session resume, restoring saved sessions with their original session IDs and working directories. by @koalazf99 Full Changelog: [dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2...dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.3](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2...dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.3)

name: v0.97.0
body:
### Highlights

- Use custom HTTP JSON search providers with configurable authentication, result mapping, and fallback engines
- Rust and TypeScript SDK clients can invoke native runtime commands and transfer sessions without turning commands into agent prompts

### Improvements

- Dismiss side panels directly from the TUI, and keep routine system notices on a compact single line
- Default opt-out usage telemetry can now include the active Anthropic or OpenAI OAuth account email when the matching server rollout is available, with a conditional one-time TUI notice, 90-day retention, and collection controls in /telemetry

### Fixes

- Azure agent turns use the Responses API with correct route selection, explicit reasoning settings, and more reliable tool-call and retry handling
- Anthropic model catalog requests include the required authentication headers
- Browser handoff failures preserve reconnect timeout diagnostics
- Empty math no longer triggers LaTeX rendering, and repeated fallback failures avoid duplicate logging

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.96.0...v0.97.0

name: v0.96.0
body:
### Highlights

- Connect to remote MCP servers over HTTP or SSE, including OAuth sign-in and command-line management
- Choose saved OAuth accounts per session from the model and login pickers, with email labels and cancelable account-switch countdowns
- SDK clients can organize sessions into collections and attach hidden reminders to individual turns

### Improvements

- Swarm messages use compact, expandable one-row previews, while the activity dock shows session icons and each worker's current todo step
- Pinned todos span the full terminal width
- The /reset usage limits claude command supports resetting Claude session limits
- Prompts and pokes appear in every window attached to a session
- New-model usage costs receive estimates before published pricing becomes available

### Fixes

- The first pinned todo update no longer hides the original session prompt, and hidden todo updates preserve transcript cache boundaries
- OpenAI native web citations render source links reliably without losing links already shown
- Provider failover honors account pools and model preferences, rotates rejected OAuth accounts, and stops retrying permanently rejected sessions
- Stale Anthropic usage is marked unavailable instead of showing misleading limits
- Browser control identifies the correct browser bridge and explains silent Chrome extension connections
- Remote MCP handshakes are bounded so unresponsive servers do not hold up startup indefinitely
- Copy-selection Enter and Y shortcuts work in client mode, and Ctrl+L keeps the fresh view when new messages arrive
- Escaped short prose lists no longer render as math, and system-notice emoji no longer leave ghost terminal cells
- SDK-launched sessions no longer flash console windows inside Windows GUI applications

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.95.0...v0.96.0

Stable releases remain on the `latest` dist-tag.

## What's Changed

### 🚀 Features

name: v0.9.90
body:
## 0.9.90 (2026-10-13)

Fourteen community pull requests: C# call-resolution and id-collision fixes, Python/Go/dedup correctness, a hub-label sidecar, a post-merge heal hook, and query/build fixes. The AST cache schema is bumped, so the first build after upgrading re-extracts.

- Fix: **C#** a nameless member-call receiver (`run.Sequence.Apply()`, `Make().Apply()`) no longer mis-binds to the caller's own same-named method; every C# member call defers and resolves only through a typed receiver (#4422, thanks @nixvideojuego-ui).
- Fix: **C#** `new X()` no longer binds to a method that shares the type's name, same-file or cross-file; a real same-named type still wins (#4428, thanks @nixvideojuego-ui).
- Feature: **C#** `foreach` loop variables are now typed from the collection's element type (arrays, known sequences, dictionary `.Keys`/`.Values`), so calls on the loop variable resolve; untypable iterables stay unresolved (#4423, thanks @nixvideojuego-ui).
- Fix: **C#** node ids now keep names that differ only by a leading/trailing `_` or by case apart (`Action`/`_Action`, `Load`/`load`, `Token`/`TOKEN`), in both ids and member-call resolution keys, instead of collapsing one onto the other (#4415, #4416, thanks @JensD-git).
- Fix: **C#** colliding ids are salted before the partial-class merge, so a partial half keeps its members and an unrelated node sharing a half's id is no longer deleted (#4411, #4412, thanks @JensD-git).
- Fix: **Go** a generic receiver type (`func (b *Box[T]) ...`) is normalized before building its id, so a generic type's methods attach to the type node instead of a separate `Box[T]` node (#4438, thanks @Goodkamalpandey).
- Fix: **Python** a module member call (`mod.func()`) now resolves when the caller is a method or nested function, by walking the enclosing scopes to the file node instead of reading only the immediate parent (#2447, #4437, thanks @SrijanSriv).
- Fix: an edge between two surviving nodes is no longer dropped just because its own `source_file` was not dispatched this run; it is kept as long as both endpoints are kept nodes (#2276, #4436, thanks @SrijanSriv).
- Fix: dedup keeps a dropped-folder document next to a top-level file that mints the same id (`protocol.md` beside `docs/protocol.md` and `docs/firmware/protocol.md`), path-qualifying the siblings instead of collapsing and losing one; a genuine reference still collapses onto the named file (#4281, #4410, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **Jinja** templates (`.j2`, `.jinja`, `.jinja2`) are now classified as documents instead of being dropped from the graph (#3427, #3455, thanks @nikhilsaxena04).
- Fix: **build** source-less placeholder nodes orphaned by a re-extraction that drops their edges are now swept on a normal (non-prune) incremental build, not just under prune; the sweep removes only code placeholders and external stubs and spares disk-isolated, fresh-isolated, and hyperedge-member nodes (#4399, thanks @Mpasha17).
- Fix: **query** the fallback traversal now retains relationships among the visited nodes (seed-to-seed edges, cycles, cross-links, and parallel relations), via the induced subgraph, instead of printing only tree edges (#4314, #4315, thanks @vibhanshu-mishra).
- Feature: **watch** hub-fallback community labels now go to a `.graphify_labels.pending.json` sidecar, so the tracked `.graphify_labels.json` holds only curated (manual/LLM) names; a promoted name drops from the sidecar and an emptied sidecar is removed (#3334, #3551, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Feature: **hooks** `graphify hook install` now also installs a `post-merge` hook that runs an unscoped background rebuild after a merge, healing a symbol the graph.json union merge driver resurrected on one side (which nothing else would re-extract), so the phantom node no longer persists (#2418, #3556, thanks @ayushcodes10).

body:
# Cua Driver 0.35.4

## Summary

This release includes 16 fixes.

## Fixes

- print the named command's help for `<command> --help`. ([#5083](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5083)) Thanks @RitikaxG, @injaneity; reported by @coygeek.
- wake Chromium AT-SPI content before the first application tree traversal. ([#5074](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5074))
- refuse background Cmd+V when the browser focus is its omnibox. ([#5124](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5124))
- keep list_windows valid when macOS reports non-finite window bounds. ([#5125](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5125)) Thanks @injaneity, @kayzenline.
- background browser clicks reach pointer-driven rows. ([#5110](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5110))
- share one approved Chrome connection across sessions. ([#5115](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5115))
- keep the Chromium screen rebase off a top-level frame that matches its window-manager frame. ([#4967](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/4967)) Thanks @CMGS.
- stop opening a console window for the embedded daemon on Windows. ([#5136](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5136)) Thanks @SunflowersLwtech.
- keep background popups and context menus open on macOS. ([#5129](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5129))
- fail type_text when a character cannot be typed. ([#5139](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5139)) Thanks @CMGS.
- preserve macOS middle-click window routing. ([#5137](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5137)) Thanks @Iflaqbhat.
- exit 64 for an unknown permissions subcommand. ([#5148](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5148)) Thanks @UlviShukurzade.
- preserve recording start timestamp in session.json. ([#5145](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5145)) Thanks @Iflaqbhat.
- isolate Computer History under CUA_DRIVER_RS_HOME. ([#5165](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5165)) Thanks @AyinLee987.
- give each character of a text its own spare keycode. ([#5158](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5158)) Thanks @CMGS.
- write action.json timestamp as ISO-8601 as documented. ([#5144](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5144)) Thanks @methanoya.

## Contributors

Thanks to @AyinLee987, @CMGS, @coygeek, @Iflaqbhat, @kayzenline, @methanoya, @RitikaxG, @SunflowersLwtech, @UlviShukurzade for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.

body:
## [1.0.0](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/compare/v0.52.0...v1.0.0) (2026-10-13)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **cli:** `rtk proxy <cmd>` is now `rtk bypass <cmd>` (the old name stays as an alias), `--ultra-compact` is removed, `rtk gain` excludes oversized outputs from its headline rate, and the default binary's licence changes (an Apache-2.0 edition, rtk-oss, ships alongside). See BREAKING_CHANGES.md.

### Features

* **cli:** pipelines in the CLI, hook gate, rtk llm-proxy ([5d8102a](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/commit/5d8102abf17d6320f3422e11e6f9fd8fc5b8a0c6))
* **engine:** pipeline engine, plugin and text crates ([62e9047](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/commit/62e9047875f837844d9f3bdeb9782e2f7c70bb9e))
* **hooks:** agent plugins honour pipeline block and route ([380a804](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/commit/380a804b1f343eddec0710c375066e664aad8b75))
* **proxy:** rtk-proxy daemon, pipelines at the request layer ([8420c11](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/commit/8420c11fc056f81b8eb064e3410a03a194e7c591))


### Bug Fixes

* **hooks:** pipeline hook rules act on Claude Code only; the shared hook core is develop's again ([2b96061](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/commit/2b96061bf6795f5ea22327770fab933c392b0b16))
* **pipeline:** route before an edit is refused; the hook load rejects tasks named after real commands; a blank message keeps a reason ([45d6ba7](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/commit/45d6ba7fb99bb232c2678b8de0b0565cd5f278ed))
* **release:** one release and one v-tag for every crate ([e61317a](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/commit/e61317a166111a75ff1d94ee40492c992a9fb8b9))
